rules.title: Costco doubles the maker's warranty to 2 years on TVs, computers and big appliances
rules.window_note: 2 years counted from the day you bought it in the warehouse, or the day it was delivered if you ordered online. This still works long after the 90-day return window has closed - it's the single most useful thing on this list for a TV or fridge that dies in year two.
rules.what_you_get: Your warranty runs for two years instead of one, so a fault in the second year still gets sorted out free. Covers TVs, projectors, computers (not touchscreen tablets) and major appliances - fridges over 10 cubic feet, freezers, ranges, cooktops, over-the-range microwaves, dishwashers, water heaters, washers and dryers.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Costco Technical and Warranty Service. Tell them what you bought, roughly when, and what's gone wrong. Have your membership number handy. English and Spanish agents, calls answered in the US.
rules.script_hint: I bought this at Costco about fourteen months ago and it's stopped working. Costco extends the manufacturer's warranty to two years - can you help me get it fixed?
rules.source_quote: Costco extends the manufacturer's warranty on the following items for up to 2 years from the date of warehouse purchase or date of delivery if the item was purchased online: Televisions Projectors Computers* Major Appliances

rules.title: L.L.Bean refunds anything for a year, no reason needed
rules.window_note: One year from the day you bought it. You don't have to prove anything is broken - not being happy with it is enough.
rules.what_you_get: All your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Mail it back or take it to an L.L.Bean store. You do need proof you bought it: a receipt, the order email, or your order history if you were signed in when you bought it.
rules.script_hint: I'm not 100 percent satisfied with this and it's less than a year old, so I'd like a refund under your guarantee.

rules.title: L.L.Bean still looks at older gear that fell apart on its own
rules.window_note: No deadline, but this only covers things that were badly made - a seam that let go, a zip that was faulty from the start. It does not cover gear you simply wore out.
rules.what_you_get: They look at it and decide. If it really is a fault in the material or the stitching, you can get a refund. This one is not automatic - it's a judgement call on their side.
rules.how_to_claim: Return it to L.L.Bean with your proof of purchase: a receipt, or their record of the sale if you gave them your details when you bought it. If you post it, put the proof of purchase in the package. Say clearly that it failed because of how it was made, not from normal use.
rules.script_hint: This seam came apart on its own - that's a craftsmanship fault, not wear and tear. Your guarantee says you'll still consider items like this after a year.
rules.source_quote: We require proof of purchase to honor a refund. If you provide us your information when you check out, we will typically have a record of your purchase. Otherwise, we require a physical receipt.

rules.title: REI takes outdoor electronics back for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days for everyone, member or not. This is the one thing the one-year member window does not stretch. Covers activity trackers, GPS devices, bike trainers, emergency communication devices and cameras.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement or all your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any REI store or start the return online, and mention it's an outdoor electronics item so they use the right window.
rules.script_hint: This GPS unit is inside the 90-day outdoor electronics window and it isn't working right - I'd like a refund or a replacement.

rules.title: MEC's guarantee covers being sold the wrong thing, not just broken things
rules.window_note: No deadline for most gear, except electronics, which have to go back within 90 days. MEC can say no to things that are worn out from normal use. Most people never claim this one because they assume a guarantee only covers faults - MEC's also covers the advice a staff member gave you.
rules.what_you_get: Money back or store credit even though nothing is broken, because the gear you were pointed at was wrong for you.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back to MEC and explain that staff recommended this for what you were doing and it turned out to be the wrong choice.
rules.script_hint: I was advised this was right for what I needed and it isn't. Your Rocksolid Guarantee covers product selection advice, so I'd like a refund or credit.
rules.source_quote: There is no time limit to make a return on qualifying product (except for electronics which are limited to 90-days).

rules.title: John Lewis puts a free 5-year guarantee on every TV
rules.window_note: 5 years from when you bought it, on every TV they sell, at no extra cost. Most TV makers only give you one or two years, so years three to five are pure John Lewis.
rules.what_you_get: A repair or a replacement TV, and you pay nothing for it.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact John Lewis customer services with your order number. Tell them the TV is faulty and that it came with their free 5-year guarantee.
rules.script_hint: This TV came with John Lewis's free 5-year guarantee and it's developed a fault - I'd like it repaired or replaced.

rules.title: Amazon refunds you itself when a third-party seller won't
rules.window_note: The order's latest delivery date must be 90 days ago or less. First ask the seller for a return (or, if it never came, contact them) and give them 48 hours. For a full refund on a return, ask for it within 30 days of delivery. It only covers items sold and shipped by the seller themselves. If you ask your card company for a chargeback, you can't use it.
rules.what_you_get: Amazon steps in and can refund you when a seller who ships its own orders won't sort out an item that arrived damaged, faulty or not as described, or that never arrived.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and ask the seller for a return. If they haven't approved it after 48 hours, go back to that order, choose Problem with Order, pick your problem, then choose Request Refund. Amazon can take up to a week to decide.
rules.script_hint: The item arrived faulty. I asked the seller for a return more than 48 hours ago and they haven't approved it, so I'm requesting an A-to-z Guarantee refund.
rules.source_quote: The item you received is damaged, defective, or not as described. AND you have requested a return more than 48 hours ago and the seller hasn't authorized your return request.

rules.title: Zappos pays the postage on returns for 60 days
rules.window_note: 60 days from the day your order arrives - start the return from your Order History and send it back inside that time. Final sale items can't go back. Heads up: older guides say Zappos gives you 365 days. That's out of date - their current policy is 60.
rules.what_you_get: All your money back (to your card or as store credit), and you don't pay a penny to ship it back, anywhere in the US including US territories and military addresses.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return from your Order History on Zappos.com, get the free label (or QR code) and drop the parcel at UPS. Shoes have to go back in their original box with no tape or labels on it, and the item has to be unworn with all tags on.
rules.script_hint: I'm returning this inside the 60-day window - I'd like the free return label.
rules.source_quote: Start your return online: Go to your Order History within your account within 60 days of receiving your order.

rules.title: Decathlon warranties its own-brand gear and pays the return postage
rules.window_note: Decathlon sets a different length for every product and prints it on that product's own page on their website. Look yours up before you give up - don't assume it has run out. Their plain 30-day return window is separate and much shorter.
rules.what_you_get: A repair or a replacement if the thing was badly made. You pay to send it in, but Decathlon pays to send it back to you.
rules.how_to_claim: Email Decathlon customer service with your receipt, the date you bought it, and photos or a short video of the fault. Keep the receipt - without it they won't process the claim.
rules.script_hint: This Decathlon-branded item has a fault in the material, not wear and tear. I'd like to claim under your limited warranty - my receipt and photos are attached.

rules.title: LG washer: 10 years on the drive motor
rules.window_note: On current LG washers: 1 year on the whole machine, including the repair work. After that it's parts only: 10 years on the direct drive motor and 3 years on the stainless steel drum (or tub on top-loaders). Some older LG washers had the drum covered for life, so check your model's warranty on LG's support site. Only the first buyer is covered, and only for machines used in the US.
rules.what_you_get: If the drive motor in your LG washer dies, LG gives you a new motor free for up to 10 years. A faulty stainless steel drum or tub is a free part for 3 years. After the first year you pay the repair person; LG pays for the part.
rules.how_to_claim: Look up your model on lg.com/us/support to check its exact warranty. Then call LG at 1-800-243-0000 with your model number, serial number and receipt, and say which part failed.
rules.script_hint: My LG washer's direct drive motor has failed. LG's limited warranty covers the direct drive motor for ten years from purchase, parts only. Please send the part under warranty.
rules.source_quote: Drum Motor: 7 Years from the Date of Purchase. Stainless Steel Drum: Lifetime

rules.title: LG dishwasher: 10 years on the Direct Drive motor
rules.window_note: On current LG dishwashers: 1 year on everything with free repair work, then parts only - 2 years on the main control board, racks, stainless tub and door liner, and 10 years on the Direct Drive motor. Some older LG dishwashers came with longer cover (5 years on the board and racks, and the stainless tub for life), so check the warranty for your model on LG's support site.
rules.what_you_get: A dead Direct Drive motor gets a free new motor for up to 10 years. After the first year you pay the repair person; LG pays for the part.
rules.how_to_claim: Look up your model on lg.com/us/support to see its exact warranty, then call LG at 1-800-243-0000 with your model number, serial number and receipt, and name the part that failed.
rules.script_hint: My LG dishwasher's Direct Drive motor has failed. LG's limited warranty covers the Direct Drive motor for ten years from purchase, parts only. I'd like the motor supplied under warranty.
rules.source_quote: Ten (10) years from date of original retail purchase Direct Drive Motor Direct Drive motor. Customer will be responsible for any labor or in-home service to replace defective parts.

rules.title: Samsung: free extra year of warranty on 2026 summer purchases
rules.window_note: Only for eligible Samsung appliances bought from a participating store between 9 July 2026 and 30 September 2026. You have to send in the claim form yourself, within 30 days after the offer ends (so by 30 October 2026).
rules.what_you_get: One extra free year of warranty on top of the normal one, so two years of parts and labour instead of one. It is free, but only if you claim it.
rules.how_to_claim: Open the Samsung SmartThings app, find the offer claim form, and submit it with your receipt. Do it as soon as you buy - do not wait, because the claim window closes shortly after 30 September 2026.
rules.script_hint: I bought this Samsung appliance during the free two-year warranty offer and I'm submitting my claim form through SmartThings to register the extra year.
rules.source_quote: at participating retailers only, purchase an eligible Samsung appliance ("Qualifying Purchase"), and submit a valid offer claim form (only available through the SmartThings™app)

rules.title: Maytag washer: 10 years on the motor and the wash basket
rules.window_note: Year 1 covers everything including the repair work. Years 2 to 10 cover the drive motor and the stainless steel wash basket only (parts), and you pay the repair person. Maytag says every washer and dryer it made after 2017 has this; older machines may differ, so check the warranty in your manual.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement drive motor or stainless wash basket up to 10 years after you bought the washer. That is usually the most expensive part of the machine.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Maytag customer service (the number is in your use and care guide) or book through maytag.com, give your model and serial number and the original purchase date, and ask for the 10-year drive motor and wash basket parts warranty.
rules.script_hint: My Maytag washer's drive motor has failed. Maytag's limited warranty covers the wash basket drive motor and the stainless steel wash basket side walls from the second through the tenth year. I'd like the part supplied under that warranty.
rules.source_quote: Get this warranty on all major kitchen and laundry appliances made after 2017. Coverage for all parts and labor during the first year is included in this decade of dependability.

rules.title: KitchenAid dishwasher: the stainless tub is covered forever
rules.window_note: 1 year on everything. Years 2 to 5 cover the nylon racks and the electronic controls (parts only). The stainless steel tub and inner door liner are covered for the life of the dishwasher - and that one includes the repair work too.
rules.what_you_get: If the stainless steel tub or inner door liner of your KitchenAid dishwasher fails, KitchenAid pays for both the part and the repair, with no time limit. Racks that fall apart and dead control boards are free parts for 5 years.
rules.how_to_claim: Call KitchenAid at 1-800-422-1230 (in Canada, 1-800-807-6777) with your model and serial number and proof of the purchase date, and name the part that failed.
rules.script_hint: My KitchenAid dishwasher's stainless steel tub has failed. KitchenAid gives a lifetime limited warranty on the stainless steel tub and inner door liner, covering parts and repair labour. Please book service under that warranty.
rules.source_quote: LIFETIME LIMITED WARRANTY (STAINLESS STEEL TUB AND INNER DOOR LINER ONLY) For the lifetime of the product from the date of original purchase

rules.title: Bosch dishwasher: rust through the tub means a new dishwasher
rules.window_note: 365 days on everything from the day it was delivered. Then 5 years on the circuit board and 5 years on the dish racks. If the stainless steel inside or the stainless door rusts right through, there is no time limit at all. All of these extras are parts only, so you pay the repair person.
rules.what_you_get: If the inner liner of your Bosch dishwasher rusts through, Bosch repairs it or replaces the dishwasher with the same model or a current one that is as good or better - no matter how old it is. They do the same for a stainless door that rusts through. Broken racks and dead circuit boards are free parts for 5 years. You pay the labour.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Bosch at 1-800-944-2904 with your model number (E-Nr) and production number (FD) from the rating label, and say the inner liner has rusted through, or that a rack or the circuit board has failed.
rules.script_hint: The inner liner of my Bosch dishwasher has rusted through. Bosch's lifetime warranty against stainless steel rust-through says you repair or replace the dishwasher. Please open a claim.
rules.source_quote: Limited warranty for rust-through on inner tub liner; parts only (lifetime)

rules.title: Bosch: the warranty stays with the appliance, not the buyer
rules.window_note: Applies for whatever is left of the warranty, counted from the day it was first delivered to the first buyer. It only works if the appliance was first bought new from an authorised Bosch dealer (not a floor model or 'as is') and has stayed in the same country. Useful if you bought a house with Bosch appliances already in it, or bought one second hand.
rules.what_you_get: You can still claim on a Bosch warranty even if you were not the person who bought the appliance. Bosch's warranty says it applies to the original buyer and to every later owner. You also do not have to have registered it - Bosch says registration is not needed for cover.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Bosch at 1-800-944-2904 with the model number (E-Nr) and production number (FD). Tell them you are a later owner. The clock runs from the day it was first delivered, so find the original invoice or delivery papers if you can - the builder, seller or last owner may have them.
rules.script_hint: I'm not the original buyer of this Bosch appliance - it came with the house. Bosch's warranty says it applies to each succeeding owner during the term, and that registration isn't necessary for coverage. Please book warranty service.
rules.source_quote: The warranties stated herein apply to the original purchaser of the product warranted herein and to each succeeding owner of the product purchased for ordinary home use during the term of the warranty.

rules.title: Miele fridge and wine cooler: 10 years on the cooling parts
rules.window_note: The cooling system is covered for 5 years with the repair work included, then for another 5 years for the part only. That is 10 years in total from the purchase date.
rules.what_you_get: If your Miele fridge, freezer or wine cooler stops cooling, the compressor, condenser, evaporator, drier, refrigerant and tubing are fixed free for 5 years, and the parts are still free in years 6 to 10.
rules.how_to_claim: Email Miele at info@mieleusa.com or call 888-996-4353 as soon as it stops cooling. Give the model and serial number and your receipt, and say it is a sealed refrigeration system fault. Your claim has to reach Miele before the 10 years are up.
rules.script_hint: My Miele wine cooler has stopped cooling. Miele's warranty covers the sealed refrigeration system for five years parts and labour and a further five years for parts. Please book service under that warranty.
rules.source_quote: such Miele Customer shall promptly contact the Miele Technical Service by sending an email to info@mieleusa.com or by calling 888-996-4353.

rules.title: Miele: 2 years, not 1, on home appliances
rules.window_note: Two full years from the purchase date, for ovens, hobs, hoods, coffee machines, fridges, dishwashers, washing machines and dryers used at home.
rules.what_you_get: Free repair, parts and labour, for two years - double the one year most brands give. Buy from an authorised Miele dealer and keep the receipt.
rules.how_to_claim: Email Miele at info@mieleusa.com or call 888-996-4353 with your model and serial number and the receipt. Say it is still inside the two-year warranty. Your claim has to reach Miele before the two years are up.
rules.script_hint: My Miele [dishwasher] has failed and it's under two years old. Miele's limited warranty for residential appliances is two years covering parts and labour, so I'd like a warranty repair booked.
rules.source_quote: such Miele Customer shall promptly contact the Miele Technical Service by sending an email to info@mieleusa.com or by calling 888-996-4353.

rules.title: Speed Queen washer and dryer: 3 to 7 years, parts and labour
rules.window_note: How long depends on the model: TR3, DR3 and FR3 get 3 years; TR5, DR5, FF7, DF7 and SF7 get 5 years; TC5 and DC5 get 5 years if the serial number is 2102000001 or higher, and 3 years if it is older; TR7 and DR7 rear-control models get 7 years. Counted from the day it was installed. The cover also passes to a new owner if you sell the machine. Watch out: if you never registered it within the first year, cover starts 30 days after it was shipped, not when you bought it.
rules.what_you_get: Speed Queen pays for both the part and the repair person for 3, 5 or 7 years depending on your model - years after other brands stop at one.
rules.how_to_claim: Find your model number on the machine, check which group it falls into, then contact your Speed Queen dealer or an Alliance Laundry Systems authorised service company and ask for warranty service.
rules.script_hint: My Speed Queen [TR7] was installed in [month, year]. That model carries seven years parts and labour under the Alliance Laundry Systems warranty bond, so please book an authorised service call under warranty.
rules.source_quote: Mechanical Timer Topload Washer TC5 Models through Serial No. 2101999999) Three (3) years parts and labor limited warranty on the complete washer.

rules.title: Dyson cordless, purifier and hair tools: 2 years, battery included
rules.window_note: 2 years from the date you bought it or the date it was delivered, whichever is later, for cordless vacuums, fans, heaters, purifiers, humidifiers, hair dryers, stylers, straighteners and audio. Dyson Renewed (refurbished) machines get 6 months or 1 year instead. No receipt? Dyson dates it 90 days after the machine was made. A battery that runs for less time because of age or use is not covered, but a battery or machine that has actually failed is. It only counts if you bought from Dyson or an authorised seller.
rules.what_you_get: Two years of free parts and labour - and that includes the battery in a cordless vacuum, which is the part that usually goes first.
rules.how_to_claim: Call the Dyson Helpline on 1-866-693-9766 with the model name, serial number and where and when you bought it. Say the battery or motor has failed.
rules.script_hint: My Dyson cordless vacuum's battery has failed and the machine is under two years old. That's a defect inside the two-year limited warranty, which covers all parts and labor. Please repair or replace it.
rules.source_quote: Reduction in battery discharge time due to battery age or use (where applicable).

rules.title: Dyson: a local repair shop does not kill your warranty
rules.window_note: Applies for as long as your warranty runs - 2 years on cordless and air treatment, 5 years on corded vacuums. If that repair later goes wrong, the damage the outside repairer caused is on them, but the rest of your warranty survives. Quote Dyson's own warranty page back at them.
rules.what_you_get: You are allowed to get your Dyson fixed at an independent repair shop, or use non-Dyson parts, without losing your warranty. Dyson says so in writing. Only damage actually caused by that outside repair is excluded.
rules.how_to_claim: If Dyson or a retailer tells you an outside repair has voided your warranty, point them at Dyson's own warranty terms and ask them to escalate. Call 1-866-693-9766.
rules.script_hint: Dyson's own limited warranty terms say I may have my machine repaired by a shop that isn't affiliated with Dyson, and use third-party parts, and that doing so will not void the warranty. So this claim is still valid.

rules.title: Shark: many vacuums have a 5-year warranty, not 1
rules.window_note: 5 years from purchase on the models that carry it - check the warranty card in the box or the manual, because some Shark models are shorter. Wear parts like filters, pads and brushrolls are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: SharkNinja repairs or replaces the vacuum for up to 5 years if it fails from a manufacturing fault. Shark pays for you to send it in. Its manuals have said it charges $19.95 to ship the fixed or new one back, so ask about any fee when you call. A replacement is covered for another 6 months or whatever is left of your original warranty, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Call SharkNinja customer service on 1-800-798-7398 to start a claim. Have your receipt and model number ready.
rules.script_hint: My Shark vacuum has stopped working and the manual says it carries a five-year limited warranty. I have my receipt. I'd like to start a warranty claim.
rules.source_quote: Five (5) Year Limited Warranty

rules.title: Roborock: 1 year new, 6 months refurbished
rules.window_note: 1 year from the purchase date for a new robot, 6 months for a certified refurbished one. In California it runs from the delivery date. No receipt? Roborock starts the clock 3 months after the robot left the factory.
rules.what_you_get: Roborock repairs it, replaces it, or refunds you if it fails from a manufacturing fault. A repaired or replaced unit is then covered for another 90 days, or the rest of your original year, whichever is longer.
rules.how_to_claim: Email Roborock customer service at support@roborock.com, or call 1-855-960-4321 (24/7, US only). Send your receipt and say what's wrong. They decide whether to repair, replace or refund.
rules.script_hint: My Roborock is under a year old and has a fault that isn't wear and tear. Roborock's limited warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship for one year from purchase. Please repair or replace it.
rules.source_quote: Please contact our Customer Service at support@roborock.com to determine whether a repair, refund or replacement is applicable.

rules.title: Best Buy takes most things back within 15 days if you're not a paid member
rules.window_note: You get 15 days from the day you receive it if you don't pay for My Best Buy Plus or My Best Buy Total. That covers new, open-box, clearance, refurbished and pre-owned items, and things sold by other sellers on the Best Buy site. Once opened, drones, cameras, lenses, camcorders and projectors cost 15% to return, except in AL, CO, HI, IA, MS, OH, OK and SC. These terms took effect on 23 February 2026, and without a receipt you only get store credit, or they can say no.
rules.what_you_get: A refund the same way you paid, or a swap for the same item. If it arrived damaged or faulty, Best Buy will set up a replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Best Buy store with everything that came in the box and your receipt or packing slip, or print a free FedEx label from your Best Buy account. For a big appliance, don't go to the store. Call 1-888-BEST BUY right away. Big appliances and TVs over 50 inches can't be shipped back.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here 10 days ago and it's faulty; it's still inside your 15-day return window, so I'd like a replacement or a refund.
rules.source_quote: If you want to return or exchange your purchase, please know that the time period begins the day you receive your product ... Standard ... Most products 15 days

rules.title: Best Buy gives you 14 days to return a phone or other cellular device
rules.window_note: Everyone gets 14 days from the day they receive it, paid members too. This covers phones, cellular tablets, mobile hotspots and cellular watches. Verizon devices get 30 days. Returning an opened device costs $45 (prepaid phones don't have this fee), except in AL, CO, HI, IA, MS, OH, OK and SC.
rules.what_you_get: A refund the same way you paid, or a swap for the same device. If it arrived damaged or faulty, Best Buy will set up a replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: First wipe your data, sign out of your cloud account and unlink the device. Take it to any Best Buy store and tell them if you want your carrier service cancelled too, or call Best Buy Mobile to return it by mail. You still have to cancel the carrier contract yourself and pay any carrier charges.
rules.script_hint: I got this phone here 9 days ago and it's faulty; devices like this have a 14-day return window, so I'd like a replacement.
rules.source_quote: Activatable devices ... 14 days 14 days *Activatable devices are devices capable of being activated and include cell phones, cellular tablets, mobile hotspots, and cellular wearables. Verizon devices capable of being activated have a 30-day return period for all customers.

rules.title: Amazon takes most things back within 30 days of delivery
rules.window_note: You have 30 days from the day it was delivered. Apple products sold new only get 15 days, and mattresses get 90. If you send something back damaged or used, you can be charged up to half the price, unless the damage was Amazon's or the seller's fault. Things a separate seller shipped themselves go back to that seller, not Amazon.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a replacement or exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and click Return Items next to the item. Most returns are free to drop off near you, often with no box or label. Wipe your personal data off any device first. Drop it off before the return-by date, or you can be charged a late fee.
rules.script_hint: This [item] arrived 2 weeks ago and it doesn't work; it's inside Amazon's 30-day return window, so I'd like a replacement.
rules.source_quote: Most items can be returned for a refund or replacement/exchange within 30 days of delivery as long as they are in original or unused condition.

rules.title: Apple products bought new on Amazon only get 15 days to return
rules.window_note: You get 15 days from delivery, not the usual 30. This covers Apple products sold in new condition, and Boost Infinite products too. After 15 days, a fault is a job for Apple's own warranty instead.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a replacement or exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and click Return Items next to the item. Turn off Find My and sign out of your Apple Account first, then drop it off before the return-by date.
rules.script_hint: My [item] arrived 10 days ago and it's faulty; Apple products on Amazon have a 15-day return window, so I'd like a replacement.
rules.source_quote: Most items sold on Amazon.com can be returned within 30 days of delivery - some exceptions include: ... 15 days Apple Brand products and Boost Infinite Brand products sold in new condition

rules.title: Amazon gives you 90 days to send back a mattress
rules.window_note: You get 90 days from delivery on mattresses sold on Amazon.com. Crib mattresses are not part of this. A mattress usually counts as heavy or bulky, so the return may cost a shipping fee or need a pickup appointment. If it comes back with signs of use that weren't Amazon's or the seller's fault, you can be charged up to half the price.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a replacement or exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and click Return Items next to the mattress. Follow the return steps it gives you, which may include booking a home pickup.
rules.script_hint: I've had this mattress for 7 weeks and it's already sagging; Amazon gives mattresses a 90-day return window, so I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Most items sold on Amazon.com can be returned within 30 days of delivery - some exceptions include: ... 90 days ... Mattresses (excluding crib mattresses)

rules.title: Refurbished Amazon Renewed items get 90 days to go back, or a year for Renewed Premium
rules.window_note: Most Renewed items get 90 days from delivery. Renewed Premium and Renewed Automotive get 365 days. Some Renewed items only get 30 days but come with a free 11-month warranty after that, so check the product page or Your Orders for your item's window.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or a replacement, and return shipping is free.
rules.how_to_claim: In Your Orders, click Get Product Support next to the Renewed item to reach a dedicated Amazon agent, or start a return. If you don't see that button and you're still inside the window, use Contact Us. Back up, factory-reset, turn off phone tracking and unlink cloud accounts before you send it, or it won't qualify.
rules.script_hint: I bought this Amazon Renewed [item] 2 months ago and it's stopped working; the Amazon Renewed Guarantee gives me 90 days, so I'd like a replacement or a refund.
rules.source_quote: Most Amazon Renewed items include a 90-day return period. Renewed Premium and Renewed Automotive items come with a 365-day return period.

rules.title: Some Amazon Renewed items come with a free 11-month warranty after the 30-day return window
rules.window_note: Only select Renewed items have this, so check your product page or order. The 11 months start after Amazon's 30-day return period ends, which covers you for about a year after delivery. It only covers items delivered in the 50 US states. Accidents, water, misuse, outside repairs and business use are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: Asurion fixes it or replaces it, or sends you an Amazon gift card or check for what you paid, minus taxes and fees. Asurion picks which one. There's no deductible.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a claim on Asurion's Amazon page, the one Amazon links to. Have your Amazon order details, and a description of the fault, ready.
rules.script_hint: My Amazon Renewed [item] has a fault and it came with the free 11-month Asurion warranty, so I'd like it repaired or replaced with no deductible.
rules.source_quote: Select Amazon Renewed items include Amazon's 30-day return period followed by a FREE 11-month limited warranty serviced by Asurion for defects in material and workmanship with no deductible.

rules.title: The Apple Store takes things back within 14 days
rules.window_note: You get 14 days from the day you receive it, and you need the receipt. It has to come back with all its parts, accessories and packaging. This only counts for things bought from Apple. Apple gear bought at another store follows that store's rules. Turn off Find My and any lock first, or Apple can refuse the return.
rules.what_you_get: A refund the way you paid, or an exchange. With a gift receipt you get an Apple Gift Card.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any US Apple Store with the receipt and they'll process your refund there, though it can take a few business days to reach your card. Or sign in to your Order Listing page, choose Start a Return, print the label and send it back. You can only return it in the country where you bought it.
rules.script_hint: I bought this at the Apple Store 10 days ago and it isn't working right; I'm inside the 14-day return window and have my receipt, so I'd like an exchange or a refund.
rules.source_quote: In the unlikely event a product is not what you expected, you can return or exchange it with a receipt within 14 days of the date you receive the product from Apple.

rules.title: Micro Center gives you 15 days to return computers, phones, cameras and main PC parts
rules.window_note: You get 15 calendar days from the day you bought it. This covers desktops, laptops, tablets, processors, motherboards, drones, digital and video cameras, projectors, cell phones and 3D printers, and open-box items get the same time as new ones. A free Micro Center account adds 14 days and PriorityCare+ doubles the time, but Microsoft Surface is always 15 days. There is no restocking fee, but a drone damaged by pilot error can't be returned.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange. If it isn't working, staff in the store will help you get it repaired or replaced for free while you're inside the window.
rules.how_to_claim: Bring it to the checkout area at any Micro Center store with everything that came in the box and the card you paid with. You can start the return in your online account first to speed it up, and with a Micro Center Insider account you don't need the receipt. Things bought in a store have to go back to a store. For an online order, start a chat on Micro Center's website.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here 12 days ago and it's faulty; I'm inside your 15-day return window, so I'd like a replacement or a refund.
rules.source_quote: Eligible return or exchange time frames are from the date of purchase: 15 calendar days Desktops Laptops Tablets Processors Motherboards Drones Digital Cameras Video Cameras Projectors Cell Phones 3D Printers

rules.title: Micro Center takes most other things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: You get 30 calendar days from the day you bought it for anything not on the 15-day list. A free Micro Center account adds 14 days and PriorityCare+ doubles the time. Earbuds, trading card games, opened software like Microsoft Office, software downloads and activation cards can't be returned, but faulty earbuds can be swapped. Things bought as a bundle have to come back together.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange, with no restocking fee. If it isn't working, staff will help you get it repaired or replaced for free while you're inside the window. If one part of a bundle is faulty, they can swap just that part if they have one in stock.
rules.how_to_claim: Bring it to the checkout area at any Micro Center store with everything that came with it and the card you paid with. You can start the return in your online account first to speed it up, and with a Micro Center Insider account you don't need the receipt. Things bought in a store have to go back to a store. For an online order, start a chat on Micro Center's website.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here 3 weeks ago and it stopped working; your policy gives me 30 days to return it, so I'd like a replacement or a refund.
rules.source_quote: 30 Day Return Policy Eligible return or exchange time frames are from the date of purchase: 30 calendar days All other products

rules.title: Staples gives you 14 days to return tech and furniture
rules.window_note: 14 days from the day you get it. That covers what Staples calls technology and business machines (it names computers, laptops, digital cameras, printers and tablets) and furniture. Bring the receipt or packing slip, with the item in its original packaging and all its manuals and parts. Furniture has to be taken apart and safe to ship, and custom furniture only comes back if it was faulty when it arrived.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap. If an online order arrives damaged or faulty, Staples will send you a replacement for free.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Staples store with the receipt. For an online order, go to My Orders, find the order, choose Return an Item and pick damaged or defective as the reason. You'll be asked if you want a free replacement. No receipt? Go back to the store where you bought it with the card you paid with so they can look it up.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 14 days ago and it doesn't work; I'd like to return it under your 14-day technology policy.
rules.source_quote: Technology and business machines, such as computers, laptops, digital cameras, printers and tablets, may be returned within 14 days of the date of receipt.

rules.title: Staples takes office supplies back at any time
rules.window_note: No time limit on office supplies, whether you bought them in a store or on staples.com. Ink and toner count too, but only if they're unopened and not past their date. Staples doesn't say which items count as office supplies, and tech like computers, printers and cameras only gets 14 days, so ask at the counter which group your item is in.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap. With no receipt you only get store credit, at the lowest price from the last 30 days.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Staples store with the receipt or packing slip, or start the return in My Orders on staples.com. No receipt? Go back to the store where you bought it with the card you paid with so they can look it up, or bring photo ID for store credit.
rules.script_hint: This is an office supply I bought here, and your policy says office supplies can be returned at any time - here's my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Office supplies may be returned at any time for both staples.com and in store purchases.

rules.title: Office Depot and OfficeMax give you 14 days to return tech and furniture
rules.window_note: 14 days for technology, electronics and furniture. Tech has to be like new and in its original packaging with the UPC code. Furniture has to be unassembled, in its box with the UPC code and all parts and manuals, and custom or special-order pieces only come back if they arrived damaged. Tech can't be returned at all without the original receipt, eReceipt, packing slip or order confirmation.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it with the original receipt to the checkout at any Office Depot or OfficeMax store. For an online order you can also go to your order history, choose Return, and print a free label to drop off at a carrier.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 14 days ago and it isn't working; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return it under your 14-day technology policy.
rules.source_quote: Technology & Electronics 14 days Original packaging with UPC code, like new condition. Furniture 14 days Unassembled and in original packaging with UPC code (including all parts and manuals)

rules.title: Office Depot's own-brand products can come back at any time
rules.window_note: No time limit, but only for products sold under the Office Depot brand name. Ink and toner don't count. Bring the original receipt. Without one you need a government ID, and you get a store Return Card for the lowest price from the last 90 days.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it with the receipt to the checkout at any Office Depot or OfficeMax store. For an online order you can also start a return by mail from your order history.
rules.script_hint: This is an Office Depot brand product, and your policy says those can be returned at any time - here's my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Office Depot® Brand Products Anytime Excludes Ink & Toner

rules.title: Office Depot and OfficeMax take unopened office supplies back for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days, but only for supplies still unopened in their original packaging. Unopened ink and toner get 30 days, and tech and electronics only get 14 days. Without the original receipt you need a government ID, and you get a store Return Card for the lowest price from the last 90 days instead of your money.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it with the receipt to the checkout at any Office Depot or OfficeMax store, or start a return by mail from your online order history.
rules.script_hint: I bought this here less than 90 days ago and it's still unopened; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Office Supplies 90 days Unopened, original packaging

rules.title: Walmart takes most things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from when you buy it or get it, for things bought in Walmart US stores, on Walmart.com or through Walmart Business. Most electronics, vacuums, heaters, fans, air purifiers and electric bikes only get 30 days, phones get 14, and most things from Marketplace sellers get 30. Anything with a rechargeable battery, like a drill, has to come back with its original battery. Walmart last updated this policy on 17 August 2026.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap. With no receipt, you need a government photo ID and you get a Walmart gift card instead.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return in the Walmart app or at walmart.com/returns. Then take it to any store or curbside, mail it back for free, or book a FedEx pickup. Bring your store receipt or order number. With no receipt, the store can try to find the purchase using the card you paid with.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it's stopped working; I'd like a refund or a replacement under your 90-day return policy.
rules.source_quote: You have 90 days after purchase or upon receipt to exchange or return an item unless noted in our exceptions.

rules.title: Walmart gives most electronics and vacuums 30 days, not 90
rules.window_note: 30 days, and you need the receipt. This covers consumer electronics, computers and computer parts, vacuums and floor cleaners, heaters, fans, air conditioners and air purifiers, and electric bikes and scooters. Computers have to come back in their original packaging, and after 30 days Walmart sends you to the maker's warranty. Opened drones and projectors can only be swapped for the same or a similar one.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Erase your personal data from the device first. Start the return in the Walmart app or at walmart.com/returns, then take it to any store, mail it back for free, or book a FedEx pickup. Bring the receipt or order number and everything that came in the box.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return it under your 30-day electronics policy.
rules.source_quote: Marketplace and Consumer Electronics items (most items are returnable within 30 days).

rules.title: Walmart gives phones only 14 days
rules.window_note: Most phones get 14 days, and you need the receipt. An unlocked phone that has been opened can only be swapped for the same or a similar phone. Verizon postpaid phones get 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back, or a swap if it's an opened unlocked phone.
rules.how_to_claim: Erase your data from the phone first. Then take it with the receipt to any Walmart store, or start the return in the Walmart app or at walmart.com/returns.
rules.script_hint: I bought this phone here less than 14 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return or exchange it.
rules.source_quote: Wireless phones, Marketplace collectible and Marketplace luxury items (most are returnable within 14 days).

rules.title: Walmart gives a full refund on big appliances only within 2 days of delivery
rules.window_note: 2 days from when you accept delivery of a fridge, freezer, washer, dryer, dishwasher, range or similar. After that, it can only come back up to 30 days if it's unopened, not installed, undamaged and still in the sealed factory box, and a Marketplace seller can charge up to 20% for that. For an opened or installed appliance after 2 days, Walmart sends you to the maker's warranty. Stores don't take these returns.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund.
rules.how_to_claim: Check it before you accept delivery - if it's damaged, tell the driver or refuse the delivery for free. After that, start the return in the Walmart app or at walmart.com/returns within 2 days of delivery so a carrier picks it up. Don't take it to a store - they won't accept it.
rules.script_hint: My [item] was delivered less than 2 days ago and it isn't working; I'd like a full refund under your 2-day major appliance policy.
rules.source_quote: Major Appliances (e.g., large refrigerators, ranges, washing machines): are returnable for a full refund within 2 days of accepted delivery.

rules.title: Target takes most things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days for most things Target sells itself, counting from the day you buy it or get your online order. The policy is written for unopened items in new condition, so Target can refuse opened or damaged items, or items without a receipt. Electronics only get 30 days, and phones and anything Apple or Beats get 14. Most things sold on Target.com by Target Plus partners get 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to Guest Services at any Target with your receipt, or the card you paid with so they can look it up. For an online order, find it under My Purchases in the Target app or on Target.com and choose Return, or Fix an issue to ask for a replacement.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it doesn't work; here's my receipt, and I'd like a refund or an exchange.
rules.source_quote: Most unopened items sold by Target in new condition and returned within 90 days will receive a refund or exchange.

rules.title: Target gives electronics 30 days, not 90
rules.window_note: 30 days for electronics and entertainment items. Anything Apple or Beats gets only 14 days, and so do phones bought in a store or online for Order Pickup. Opened video games, software, music and movies can only be swapped for the same title.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to Guest Services at any Target with your receipt, or the card you paid with so they can look it up. For an online order, find it under My Purchases in the Target app or on Target.com and choose Return, or Fix an issue to ask for a replacement.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Electronics and entertainment items (excluding Apple® & Beats products) must be returned / exchanged within 30 days.

rules.title: Target gives Apple and Beats products only 14 days
rules.window_note: Anything Apple or Beats bought at Target, phones included, has to come back within 14 days. That's shorter than the 30 days other electronics get. An opened iPhone can carry a restocking charge of up to $35 where the law allows it.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid, or a swap, minus up to $35 if it's an opened iPhone.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to Guest Services at any Target with your receipt, or the card you paid with so they can look it up. If you bought it at the Target Tech counter, return it there. For an online order, start it under My Purchases in the Target app or on Target.com.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 14 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: All Apple® & Beats products (including mobile phones) must be returned / exchanged within 14 days.

rules.title: Target gives phones only 14 days
rules.window_note: Phones bought in a Target store, or online for Order Pickup, have to come back within 14 days. An opened phone can carry a restocking charge of up to $35 where the law allows it. There's no charge if it's unopened. Phones on a carrier contract must go back in store with a Target Tech rep, and your carrier may charge an early termination fee.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back or a swap, minus up to $35 if the phone was opened.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the phone, its box and accessories to a Target store with your receipt. If you bought it at Target Tech or on a carrier contract, return it at Target Tech.
rules.script_hint: I bought this phone here less than 14 days ago and it's faulty; here's my receipt, and I'd like to return or exchange it.
rules.source_quote: Mobile phones purchased in-store or online via Order Pickup must be returned / exchanged within 14 days.

rules.title: Currys fixes faulty items for 12 months, and refunds them in the first 30 days
rules.window_note: Everything Currys sells comes with a standard 12-month warranty from the day you bought it. In the first 30 days (from when you bought it or had it delivered) you can have an exchange or a refund. After that, Currys may repair it while the 12 months last. Accidental damage, misuse, neglect and normal wear and tear are not covered, and some makers give you longer than 12 months, so check the box too.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange or your money back in the first 30 days. After that, a repair while it is still inside its guarantee.
rules.how_to_claim: On the Returns page of the Currys site, choose 'I want a refund' or 'I want an exchange' and answer the questions about the fault. Have your receipt or order confirmation ready - if you bought online, log in to your Currys account to find it. Or call Currys.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] from Currys less than a year ago and it has developed a fault, so it's still inside your standard 12-month warranty and I'd like it repaired.
rules.source_quote: If more than 30 days have passed since you bought or received your item, we might be able to repair it as long as it’s still within its guarantee period (usually 12 months from when you bought it).

rules.title: Currys takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days. Bought online: you can open it to look it over, but for a full refund it must be unused, like new, in its original box with all its accessories. Bought in a store: it must still be sealed and unopened, and you need your proof of purchase. Some things can't come back once the seal is broken, for hygiene reasons, unless they are faulty. Phones and SIMs on a contract follow the network's own rules.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund, or an exchange if you'd rather.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to the Returns page on the Currys site and follow the steps. Most online orders can also go back to a Currys store. Bring it in its box with every accessory, plus your receipt or order confirmation.
rules.script_hint: I bought this online less than 30 days ago and it's unused and back in its original box with everything, so I'd like a full refund under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you bought your item online, you can return it within 30 days - even if you’ve opened it for inspection. To get a full refund, the item must be returned like new and in a resaleable condition.

rules.title: Argos repairs or replaces faulty items free for 12 months
rules.window_note: In the first 30 days after you got it, a faulty item gets you a refund, and it does not need its box, tags or to be unused. From then until 12 months, Argos offers a free repair or replacement. If that doesn't fix it, takes too long or causes you real hassle, they offer a refund instead. Things sold by a Trusted Seller on the Argos site go back to that seller, not to an Argos store.
rules.what_you_get: A refund in the first 30 days. After that, up to 12 months, a free repair or replacement, and a refund if that doesn't work.
rules.how_to_claim: If you collected it from a store, take it back to any Argos store. If it was delivered to your home, get in touch through the Argos contact page or live chat. Have your receipt or order confirmation ready.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] from Argos less than 12 months ago and it has developed a fault, so I'd like the free repair or replacement your policy offers.
rules.source_quote: If something goes wrong after the first 30 days but within 12 months, we'll offer to repair or replace the item at no cost to you.

rules.title: Argos gives you 30 days to change your mind
rules.window_note: 30 days from the day you collected it or it was delivered. It must be unused, with all its parts, in its original packaging and fit to sell again, and you need proof of purchase. You can't return personalised items, opened games, DVDs or software, or hygiene items like earphones, razors and toothbrushes once they are used or unsealed. Items from Trusted Sellers follow the seller's own returns.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back the way you paid. Allow 14 days once they have it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return online with your order number, email and postcode, then take small items to any Argos store. Big items like sofas and fridges have to be collected, so arrange that on live chat. Collection costs £3.95 for small items and £30 for large ones, unless the item is faulty.
rules.script_hint: I got this less than 30 days ago and it's unused in its original packaging, so I'd like to return it under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you've changed your mind and wish to return an item, you have 30 days from the date of collection or from the date of delivery to request to return your item(s).

rules.title: Argos lets you swap a mattress you can't sleep on within 100 nights
rules.window_note: Within the first 100 days. One swap per purchase, for the same size only, and it must be clean and undamaged, so use a mattress protector. It is for home use only, and mattresses for adjustable beds are not covered. If you paid with an Argos Monthly Payment Plan, PayPal or Klarna, you can only swap for a mattress with the same catalogue number.
rules.what_you_get: A swap for a different mattress in the same size. If the new one is cheaper you get the difference back; if it costs more, you pay the difference.
rules.how_to_claim: Get in touch through the Argos contact page or live chat, or ask in an Argos store, and say you want to exchange your mattress under the 100-night comfort promise.
rules.script_hint: I'm not sleeping well on the mattress I bought from you less than 100 days ago, so I'd like to exchange it under your 100-night comfort promise.
rules.source_quote: If you're not sleeping soundly on your new mattress, you can exchange it within the first 100 days.

rules.title: Amazon UK takes most things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from when it arrived. It has to be unused and undamaged, in the same state you got it. Hygiene items you've unsealed, opened software, personalised items and things that go off can't go back unless they are faulty. Amazon Haul items only get 15 days. Sending it back is free if it said Free Return when you bought it; otherwise the cost comes off your refund, unless the item is faulty, damaged or wrong.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders and start a return in the Online Returns Centre, then use the drop-off or collection option it gives you. Remove any personal data and sign the device out of your accounts first.
rules.script_hint: This arrived less than 30 days ago and it's unused and undamaged, so I'd like to return it under Amazon's 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: you can return most products from the Amazon sites to Amazon within 30 days of receipt of the products if the products are in an unused and undamaged condition.

rules.title: Amazon UK repairs faulty items it sold you after the 30 days are up
rules.window_note: This starts once the 30-day return window has passed, and only covers items sold by Amazon.co.uk itself or Amazon Resale, not other sellers. The repair is free while the maker's warranty still covers the fault. That is often a year, but check the box or listing, because Amazon's page doesn't set its own limit. Batteries, ink, bulbs and other things that get used up are not covered, and neither is accidental damage or normal wear and tear.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair by the maker or a repairer the maker approves. If it can't be repaired, a replacement; if there's no replacement, your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders. If the item can be repaired, you'll see an option to send it for repair and make a repair label, and Amazon pays you back any postage. Back up and wipe it first. If there's no repair option, contact Amazon customer service.
rules.script_hint: This [item] was sold by Amazon.co.uk and has developed a fault after the 30-day return window, so I'd like it repaired under your policy for defective items.
rules.source_quote: If your item becomes defective after the Amazon return period, Amazon will repair any defective item.

rules.title: Amazon UK refunds you itself when a Marketplace seller won't
rules.window_note: Up to 90 days from the last delivery date on the order, and only for items a Marketplace seller both sold and dispatched. Ask the seller for a return first. If they don't agree within 48 hours or don't fix it, you can claim. You can't claim if you have already done a chargeback with your bank.
rules.what_you_get: Amazon refunds you when the item arrived damaged, faulty or not as described and the seller won't sort it out.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to Your Orders, find the order, choose Problem with order, pick your problem, then Request Refund. Add a short note and submit. Amazon can take up to a week to decide and tells you by email.
rules.script_hint: The seller didn't agree to take back this faulty item within 48 hours, so I'm asking for a refund under the A-to-z Guarantee.
rules.source_quote: You can request a refund under the A-to-z Guarantee when: A Marketplace Seller sold and dispatched the item you ordered, and; The last delivery date of your order is 90 days or less, and;

rules.title: John Lewis takes things back within 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days, with your receipt or order confirmation. It must be unused, with all its packaging and labels in good condition, and it can't hold your personal data or be registered with the maker. Mattresses, bedding, earrings, opened beauty products, personalised items and opened software can't come back unless they are faulty. Big items that need collecting cost £29.95 to return unless they are faulty or damaged.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange, or a refund to the way you paid within 14 days of sending it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back to a John Lewis shop. If you bought online, you can also use a Waitrose shop, a Click & Collect point or the post - sign in to your John Lewis account to start the return.
rules.script_hint: I bought this less than 30 days ago and it's unused with all its packaging and labels, so I'd like to return it under your 30-day returns policy.
rules.source_quote: If you've changed your mind about keeping your purchase, please return it within 30 days in its original condition with proof of purchase. We'll exchange or refund it

rules.title: John Lewis swaps or refunds anything that turns out faulty in the first 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from when you bought it, for a fault in how it was made - not damage you caused. Bring proof of purchase, turn off any security features and remove your personal data. After 30 days John Lewis will still repair or replace it under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, and electricals also get John Lewis's own longer guarantee.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange or your money back. After 30 days, a repair or a replacement.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back with your receipt or order confirmation, or get in touch through the Product problems & guarantees part of the John Lewis contact page.
rules.script_hint: This developed a manufacturing fault within 30 days of buying it here, so under your returns policy I'd like an exchange or a refund.
rules.source_quote: If your product develops a manufacturing fault within 30 days of purchase, please return with proof of purchase and we’ll exchange or refund it.

rules.title: Very takes most things back free within 28 days
rules.window_note: 28 days from when you received it. It must be complete, unused, in its original packaging and with any security tags still on. Some items are left out or have extra conditions, and the product page says so. Sending it back under this guarantee is free.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to your card, or a credit to your Very account if you bought on credit, usually within 5 working days of Very getting it back.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to My Orders in your Very account, choose Return items, pick the item and the reason, then drop it at an InPost locker or shop, or book a home collection. You don't need a printer.
rules.script_hint: I received this less than 28 days ago and it's unused and complete in its original packaging, so I'd like a refund under your 28-day Approval Guarantee.
rules.source_quote: We will refund most goods provided they are returned to us within 28 days of receipt complete, unused, in their original packaging and with any security tags intact.

rules.title: Very has to sort out faulty items, even when it sends you to the maker
rules.window_note: Very covers anything that fails early because of a manufacturing fault. For electricals and furniture, Very may give you a supplier helpline to call. If that helpline lets you down, tell Very and it will take the problem back. Very's page gives no time limit, so the 6 years here comes from UK law (5 years in Scotland).
rules.what_you_get: A repair, a replacement or a refund, depending on the fault.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to My Orders in your Very account, choose to return the item, pick 'Faulty' as the reason and describe the problem in detail. For some items Very will show you a number to call instead. If the fault is a safety worry, call Very.
rules.script_hint: This [item] from Very has failed early because of a manufacturing fault, so I'd like a repair, replacement or refund, and if the supplier helpline can't help I'd like Very to take it back over.
rules.source_quote: If any product we supply fails prematurely due to an inherent fault (manufacturing defect) we will provide you with an appropriate remedy e.g. a repair, replacement, or refund.

rules.title: Home Depot takes most things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from purchase for most things, with proof of purchase. Home Depot can turn down something you damaged yourself, but a factory fault is fine. Some things get less time: 30 days for TVs, computers, furniture and gas garden tools, 7 days for dehumidifiers, air conditioners and gas generators, and 48 hours for big appliances. With no receipt you may only get store credit at the lowest advertised price and you'll need photo ID, and special orders may cost a 15% restocking fee.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back. Without proof of purchase, you may get store credit at the lowest advertised price instead.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store, even if you bought it online, with your receipt or shipping confirmation email, the card you paid with and photo ID. For an online order you can also start a return from Order Details in your Home Depot account and get a UPS label.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like to return it under your 90-day policy.
rules.source_quote: Most merchandise can be returned within 90 days with proof of purchase to The Home Depot unless noted below.

rules.title: Home Depot takes back TVs, computers and furniture for only 30 days, and only unopened
rules.window_note: 30 days for furniture, TVs, computers, tractors, framing and roofing compressors, paint sprayers, and gas-powered trimmers, blowers, chain saws, mowers, outdoor augers, tillers, chippers and log splitters. The policy says it has to be unused and still in its factory-sealed box, so a TV that broke after you set it up may be turned down - if so, the maker's warranty is your next stop. Since 7 July 2026, Halloween and holiday decor also get 30 days. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back for an unused item still in its sealed box.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store with your receipt or shipping confirmation email, the card you paid with and photo ID. Gas-powered tools can't be mailed back, so they have to go to a store.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and it's still unused in the sealed box, so I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Return in 30 Days Furniture, Tractors, Framing & Roofing Compressors, Consumer Electronics (televisions and computers), Paint Sprayers and Gas Powered Items in the following categories: Trimmers, Blowers, Chain Saws, Mowers

rules.title: Home Depot gives dehumidifiers, air conditioners and gas generators just 7 days
rules.window_note: 7 days for dehumidifiers, window and portable air conditioners, gas pressure washers and gas generators (not whole-house or stationary ones). Since 7 July 2026 the same 7 days applies to pumps, portable evaporative coolers and portable heaters. It has to be unused and in its factory-sealed box. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back for an unused item still in its sealed box.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Home Depot store with your receipt, the card you paid with and photo ID. Anything that uses gas or fuel can't be mailed back, so it has to go to a store.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 7 days ago and it's unused in the sealed box, so I'd like to return it.
rules.source_quote: Return in 7 Days Dehumidifiers, Gas Pressure Washers, Air Conditioners (Window and Portable), Gas Generators (other than whole house and stationary generators). All product must be unused and in their original factory-sealed packaging.

rules.title: Home Depot gives you 48 hours to report a damaged or faulty big appliance
rules.window_note: 48 hours from delivery or store pickup, not counting weekends, for fridges, washers, dryers, ranges, dishwashers and over-the-range or built-in microwaves. Every return on these, even unopened ones, has to happen inside those 48 hours. Check it before you accept delivery and refuse it if it's damaged. The Home Depot card's 365 days does not stretch this.
rules.what_you_get: Home Depot takes the damaged or faulty appliance back if you report it in time. Ask whether they will pick it up from your home.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Customer Solutions at 1-800-455-3869 (6 a.m. to 2 a.m., 7 days) or text "Support" to 38698 within 48 hours of delivery or pickup. If you paid by debit with PIN, cash, cheque, store credit or gift card, bring the receipt to a store for the refund.
rules.script_hint: My [item] was delivered yesterday and it's damaged, so I'm reporting it inside your 48-hour window for major appliances.
rules.source_quote: For Major Appliances (including refrigerators, washers, dryers, ranges, dishwashers, and over-the-range or built-in microwaves), contact Customer Solutions at 1-800-455-3869 within 48 hours of delivery (excluding weekends) for any damage or defects.

rules.title: Home Depot gives you 30 days to report an order that arrived broken or missing parts
rules.window_note: 30 days from delivery if your order shows up damaged, incomplete, or needing replacement parts. Big appliances are different: those have to be reported within 48 hours. Home Depot doesn't say exactly what the fix will be, so ask for what you need.
rules.what_you_get: Home Depot sorts the order out - ask for the missing parts, a replacement or a refund.
rules.how_to_claim: Text "Support" to 38698 any time, or call 1-800-430-3376 (6 a.m. to 2 a.m. ET, 7 days) within 30 days of delivery. Have your order number ready.
rules.script_hint: My order arrived damaged less than 30 days ago, and your policy says to contact you within 30 days of delivery to get it put right.
rules.source_quote: If an order arrives damaged or incomplete or needs replacement parts, contact Customer Support ... within 30 days of delivery for resolution.

rules.title: Home Depot replaces Husky hand tools for free if they ever fail
rules.window_note: No time limit on Husky hand tools such as wrenches, sockets, ratchets, pliers, hammers, screwdrivers, knives, and garden tools like rakes and shovels. Other Husky gear has shorter warranties that need a receipt: 5 years on heavy-duty tool chests and tool belts, 3 years on air tools, air hoses, extension cords and work lights, 2 years on wheelbarrows and bins, and 1 year on jacks and jump starters. Misuse, abuse and normal wear are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement. For the limited-lifetime items, a replacement worth the same or more.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the broken Husky tool to any Home Depot store. For Husky items with a 1- to 5-year warranty, bring the receipt too.
rules.script_hint: This Husky [item] broke, and Husky hand tools have a lifetime warranty, so I'd like a free replacement.
rules.source_quote: If your Husky product ever fails, bring it back and we will replace it for free.

rules.title: Lowe's takes most new, unused things back within 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days from purchase for most new, unused things. Lowe's won't take anything back without proof of purchase, but it can find the sale from your order number, the card you paid with, your phone number or your MyLowe's account. Some things get less time: 48 hours for big appliances and some power gear, and 30 days for TVs, electronics and most outdoor power equipment. Special orders returned after 72 hours cost a 20% restocking fee.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt, or start the return from your order history on Lowes.com. Online orders can be mailed back if they came with a FedEx label. They may ask for photo ID.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and I'd like to return it under your 90-day policy.
rules.source_quote: Most new, unused merchandise can be refunded or exchanged with receipt within 90 days of the original purchase date, unless noted in our Return Policy Exceptions.

rules.title: Paying with a Lowe's card gives you 365 days to return most things
rules.window_note: 365 days instead of 90 if you paid with a MyLowe's Rewards Credit Card, MyLowe's Pro Rewards Credit or American Express card, a Lowe's Commercial Account or Lowe's Business Rewards. Lowe's Pay does not count. Lowe's says the 365 days apply unless an item is listed as an exception, so the short windows for TVs, electronics and outdoor power gear may still apply - ask. Big appliances and other 48-hour items get 30 days with the card.
rules.what_you_get: A full year to return it for a refund or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt and the Lowe's card you paid with, so they can find the purchase.
rules.script_hint: I paid with my Lowe's card, which gives me 365 days to return this instead of 90.
rules.source_quote: MyLowe’s Rewards™ Credit Card (MLRCC) or Lowe’s Business Rewards (LBR): May be returned within 365 days of the date of purchase, unless noted below.

rules.title: Lowe's gives big appliances, generators and some power tools just 48 hours
rules.window_note: 48 hours from delivery or store pickup for fridges, freezers, washers, dryers, ranges, hoods, dishwashers, over-the-range microwaves, cooktops and wall ovens, and also for air conditioners, evaporative coolers, paint sprayers, tile saws, portable generators, pressure washers and chainsaws. If it's still unopened and factory-sealed, or you paid with a Lowe's card, you get 30 days instead - but generators, pressure washers, chainsaws and pole saws don't get the card's extra time. Lowe's Outlet stores only take back appliances that don't work, within 48 hours, at the same outlet.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or exchange, as long as you start the return inside 48 hours. For big items, ask about home pickup.
rules.how_to_claim: Start the return within 48 hours: call Lowe's customer care at 1-800-445-6937 to talk about home pickup, or bring it back to your nearest store with your receipt.
rules.script_hint: My [item] was delivered less than 48 hours ago and I need to start a return under your 48-hour policy.
rules.source_quote: Return must be initiated with Lowe’s within 48 hours of delivery or the time of pickup at a Lowe’s location. Major Appliances: Refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, ranges, range hoods, dishwashers

rules.title: Lowe's gives TVs, electronics and most mowers and yard power tools just 30 days
rules.window_note: 30 days from purchase for TVs and electronics, water heaters, heating and cooling systems, and most outdoor power equipment like lawn mowers, leaf blowers, trimmers, snow blowers, tillers and log splitters. CRAFTSMAN battery and electric outdoor tools are the exception - they get the normal 90 days.
rules.what_you_get: A refund to the way you paid, or an exchange.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Lowe's store in the US with your receipt. For something too big to carry, call customer care at 1-800-445-6937 to ask about home pickup.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 30 days ago and I'd like to return it within your 30-day window.
rules.source_quote: You can return these items within 30 days of purchase: Liquid paint, TVs and electronics, Water heaters, Most outdoor power equipment

rules.title: Lowe's will book a free in-home repair if the maker's warranty covers it
rules.window_note: Lowe's sets no deadline of its own for this. The repair is free only if the maker's warranty still covers the fault; if it doesn't, the technician may offer to fix it at your cost. Lowe's doesn't list which products this covers, but it describes a repair visit at your home, so it fits big appliances best.
rules.what_you_get: A factory-certified technician comes to your home, and the repair costs you nothing if the maker's warranty covers it.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Lowe's Service Advantage at 1-888-77-LOWES (1-888-775-6937) to book the visit. Have your Lowe's receipt handy.
rules.script_hint: My [item] from Lowe's has stopped working and it's still under the maker's warranty, so could you set up a factory-certified repair visit?
rules.source_quote: hotline toll-free at 1-888-77-LOWES (56937) to set up a factory-certified service appointment in your home or for general assistance. If the repair is covered by the manufacturer’s warranty, it will be repaired at no cost to you.

rules.title: Lowe's fixes or replaces faulty Kobalt tools for 1 year up to a lifetime
rules.window_note: There's no single deadline: most Kobalt products made after 1 May 2016 carry a guarantee of 1, 3 or 5 years or a lifetime, and the length is on the packaging, the manual, or the tool's page on Lowes.com. Items with the tool/battery badge get 5 years on the tool and 3 years on the battery. It covers faults in materials and workmanship, not misuse, normal wear or parts meant to wear out.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair or replacement. Tools with the Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee get a free replacement, no questions asked.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the tool and your proof of purchase back to Lowe's, where you bought it, or call 1-888-3KOBALT.
rules.script_hint: This Kobalt [item] has a fault and it's still inside its guarantee, so I'd like it repaired or replaced at no charge.
rules.source_quote: If you think your product meets the above guarantee criteria, please return it to the place of purchase with valid proof of purchase and the defective product will be repaired or replaced at no charge.

rules.title: Lowe's replaces or refunds trees, shrubs and perennials for a year
rules.window_note: One year from purchase for trees, shrubs and perennials, and you need the receipt. Every other plant gets 30 days.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement plant or your money back.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the plant and your receipt to the customer service desk at any Lowe's.
rules.script_hint: This shrub I bought here died within a year, and your policy covers trees, shrubs and perennials for a year with the receipt.
rules.source_quote: For replacement or refund, a receipt is required for any tree, shrub or perennial purchased at Lowe’s within one year of the original purchase date.

rules.title: GameStop takes new games and gear back for 15 days, and swaps faulty ones
rules.window_note: 15 days from purchase. Unopened new games, consoles, accessories, collectibles and unworn clothing with tags come back for a refund; once opened, they can only be swapped if they're faulty, and only inside the same 15 days. Special and collector's editions get just 7 days. Trading cards, clearance, digital and seasonal items are final sale.
rules.what_you_get: Unopened: your money back to the way you paid. Opened and faulty: a swap for the same item. If they have none left, they may offer store credit.
rules.how_to_claim: Bring it with all its parts and packaging, plus your receipt or GameStop.com order number, to a GameStop store - things bought in a store must go back to a store. They may ask for photo ID. Online orders over $500 can't go back to a store, so call 1-800-883-8895.
rules.script_hint: This [item] stopped working and I bought it here less than 15 days ago, so I'd like to swap it for the same one under your defective exchange policy.
rules.source_quote: New Products (Unopened): Return within 15 days of purchase. ... General Items: Defective products (excluding PCs, PC components, laptops, TVs, and monitors) can be exchanged for an identical replacement within the return window.

rules.title: GameStop swaps a faulty pre-owned game or console within 15 days
