Marketplace items can't be exchanged, but carry at least a 90-day warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A free swap for another item.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the item and your receipt or order confirmation email to any Coppel store and ask for a cambio. Or contact Coppel on +52 559 500 0001 (phone or WhatsApp) or atencion@coppel.com. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] at Coppel less than 30 days ago and it isn't right, so I'd like the free exchange you offer within 30 days.
rules.source_quote: Para artículo de Muebles, dispones de un plazo de 30 días posteriores a tu fecha de compra para solicitar un cambio sin costo por insatisfacción.

rules.title: Coppel clothes with a sewing fault can be exchanged for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 days for a fault in how the garment was made (defectos de confección); 30 days if you just don't like it. Underwear, shapewear, perfume and personal-care items can't be exchanged.
rules.what_you_get: An exchange for another garment.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to any Coppel store with your receipt or order email and ask for a cambio for a manufacturing defect. Or contact Coppel on +52 559 500 0001 (phone or WhatsApp). If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: The seams on this came apart within 90 days, and Coppel allows exchanges for sewing defects for 90 days, so I'd like to swap it.
rules.source_quote: Para artículos de Ropa, dispones de un plazo de 30 días para cambios por insatisfacción y 90 días si es por defectos de confección.

rules.title: Paid for Coppel's Garantía Extendida? Unlimited repairs, or a new one if it can't be fixed
rules.window_note: Only if you bought it. It stretches the free Garantía Coppel by 1 or 2 more years, up to 4 years in all, on new products. Power surges are covered from the first day. You have to claim while the plan is still active. It covers audio and video, computers, tablets and video games, big and small appliances, heating and ventilation, home and bedroom, office, terrace and garden, home improvement, and beauty and personal care.
rules.what_you_get: Unlimited repairs with original parts, and a replacement if it can't be repaired. It works at any Coppel store in Mexico.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to the Soluciones al Cliente desk at your nearest Coppel store while the plan is active. Bring the item if you can carry it; if it's too big or heavy, Coppel sends a driver to collect it from your home. Uninstalling and reinstalling is up to you. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: My [item] has Coppel's Garantía Extendida and it has a factory fault, so I'd like it repaired, or replaced if it can't be fixed.
rules.source_quote: 1.Reparaciones ilimitadas con piezas originales, 2. Cobertura contra descarga eléctrica desde el primer día, 3. Reemplazo del producto en caso de no poder ser reparado

rules.title: Elektra stores: 15 days to swap or cancel a faulty purchase
rules.window_note: 15 calendar days from purchase, for things bought in an Elektra store or online with store pickup. It has to have a factory fault, come with its box and all its parts (fridges, stoves, washers, furniture and bikes don't need the box), and have no knocks, cracks, water or pests. Not covered: Telcel phones (Elektra's returns page adds AT&T phones), Apple products, motorcycles and helmets, and anything you damaged. From day 16, Elektra helps with the maker's warranty instead.
rules.what_you_get: The same product or a similar one, or the order cancelled and your money back the way you paid. If you pick something cheaper you don't get the difference back; if it costs more you pay the difference in cash.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the item, its box and all its accessories to any Elektra store. For Mabe, Whirlpool, LG, Samsung, Winia, Koblenz, Calorex, Mirage and Panasonic, the maker checks it first, within 7 days; big items like washers, fridges, stoves and TVs over 32 inches are checked at home (call 55 7577 5547 or ask in store to open a service order). Other brands are tested in the store on the spot. To cancel, bring every item in the order. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] at Elektra less than 15 days ago and it has a factory defect, so under your 'defecto de fábrica o no funciona' guarantee I'd like it exchanged or my order cancelled.
rules.source_quote: 3. “DEFECTO DE FÁBRICA O NO FUNCIONA”, VÁLIDO DURANTE LOS 15 DÍAS NATURALES A PARTIR DE LA COMPRA.

rules.title: Elektra online orders delivered to your home: 30 days to send them back
rules.window_note: 30 calendar days from the day you receive it, for orders from elektra.mx or the Elektra app. Reasons Elektra accepts: wrong item, you don't like it, it arrived incomplete, or it's damaged. For a defect you can also ask for the same or a similar item within those 30 days. Pack it with every accessory in its original box. Not returnable: mobile phones once received, installed appliances, Italika motorcycles, printer cartridges and software; mattresses only if still sealed. For items from outside sellers, report damage to electronics, phones, appliances and furniture within 24 hours. Heads up: Elektra's short returns help page (elektra.mx/devoluciones) still shows a 5-business-day window, so start early.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back once Elektra accepts the return, which it says takes 5 to 10 business days. If you bought on Elektra credit, you get the down payment and the weekly payments back.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Elektra's Centro de Soluciones Asistidas on 55 7577 5547, or start the return in the app or website if self-service is on. They send a prepaid label or book a courier pickup; big items are collected from your home. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: My Elektra order arrived less than 30 days ago and it's faulty, so under your return policy I'd like to send it back for a refund.
rules.source_quote: el Consumidor tendrá hasta 30 (treinta) días naturales posteriores a la fecha de recibido el producto adquirido para notificar a OPERADORAS EN SERVICIOS COMERCIALES, S.A. DE C.V. el hecho

rules.title: After 15 days, Elektra still helps with your warranty claim, and steps in if the maker doesn't follow up
rules.window_note: Starts on the 16th day after you get the item and lasts as long as the maker's warranty printed in the box. This is for things bought in an Elektra store, or online and picked up in store. Not for Telcel, AT&T or Movistar phones (claim with the carrier: *264 for Telcel, *611 for AT&T, Unefon and Movistar), Apple products (Apple Store or an Apple-authorised service centre), or Italika motorcycles.
rules.what_you_get: Elektra opens a service order and the maker decides whether to repair or replace it, with a fix due within 30 days of the order. The maker does the diagnosis and repair; Elektra's part is opening the order and following it up. If the maker doesn't follow up, Elektra reviews the service order and gives you a solution itself.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the item and your receipt (you must have it) to any Elektra store to open a service order, or call 55 7577 5547, option 3 then option 2, with the order number, store number and SKU from your receipt. Big or installed items stay at home for the maker's visit. If 30 days pass with no fix, ask the store to apply Elektra's own solution. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: My [item] from Elektra has a factory fault under the maker's warranty, so I'd like you to open a service order, and if the maker doesn't follow up, your terms say Elektra will give me a solution.
rules.source_quote: En caso de que Proveedor no de seguimiento para la solución de la garantía, Elektra validará la información de la orden de servicio y proporcionará una solución para el Cliente.

rules.title: Paid for Elektra's Garantía Extendida? A swap if repairs drag on
rules.window_note: Only if you bought Garantía Extendida Elektra, which is issued by Comercializadora de Motos y Garantías CMG. It runs up to 5 years for big and small appliances, electronics, furniture, mattresses and consoles, and 3 years for computers, peripherals, tablets, e-scooters and phones, counted from delivery. Not covered: rough handling, knocks and drops, misuse, and repairs by unauthorised people.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement for any fault in the first 90 days, after an authorised service centre checks it. After that, unlimited repairs, including power-surge damage. You get the same or a similar product if a repair takes more than 20 days, after more than 3 repairs, when the repair would cost 80% or more of the item, or when parts aren't available.
rules.how_to_claim: Take small items to any Elektra store with your receipt (you must have it) to open a service order, or call 55 7577 5547, option 3 then option 3, with the order number, store number and SKU from your receipt. Big or installed items stay at home for a service visit. Elektra says it resolves claims within 20 days of the service order. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: My [item] has Garantía Extendida Elektra and the repair has taken more than 20 days, so under the plan I'd like it swapped for the same or a similar product.
rules.source_quote: Cambio físico por el mismo producto o cambiar por un producto de características similares en los siguientes casos: Si tardamos más de 20 días naturales en reparación

rules.title: Costco México takes back electronics and big appliances for 90 days
rules.window_note: 90 calendar days from the day you bought it. Costco's examples include TVs, computers, tablets, cameras, drones, consoles, phones, headphones, speakers, smart watches, monitors, fridges over 10 cubic feet, freezers, stoves, microwaves, dishwashers, water heaters, washers and dryers, plus generators, pressure washers, smart home and security gear. Costco's membership contract puts all appliances (electrodomésticos) in the 90-day group, so treat small appliances as 90 days to be safe. It must come back in its original box with all its parts.
rules.what_you_get: A full refund, to the same way you paid.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to the Devoluciones counter at any Costco México warehouse, in its original box with all accessories and manuals. Online orders can also be returned through costco.com.mx. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 90 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like to return it under your 90-day policy for electronics and appliances.
rules.source_quote: En el caso de productos de Electrónica y Línea Blanca, Costco solo aceptará devoluciones dentro de los siguientes 90 días naturales contando a partir de la fecha en que el socio adquirió el producto.

rules.title: Everything else at Costco México can come back for a year
rules.window_note: 365 calendar days from purchase, for anything that isn't electronics, an appliance or perishable food: things like furniture, mattresses, clothes, shoes, luggage, toys, bikes, cookware and outdoor gear. Power tools aren't named as electronics either, but Costco does put generators and pressure washers in its 90-day group. Costco's policy page promises a full refund if you're not satisfied, and its membership contract sets the one-year limit. No returns on alcohol, cigarettes, gasoline, controlled medicines or gold bars. Bring it in its original packaging with all its parts.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back, to the same way you paid.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to the Devoluciones counter at any Costco México warehouse with your membership and the receipt or invoice (CFDI). Online orders can be returned at a warehouse or through costco.com.mx. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than a year ago and it's faulty, and Costco's membership contract gives 365 days for returns, so I'd like my money back.
rules.source_quote: En cualquier otro caso, el plazo de devolución será de 365 (trescientos sesenta y cinco) días naturales, contados a partir de la fecha de adquisición del producto o servicio de que se trate.

rules.title: Paid for Costco México's extended warranty on a computer or tablet? A new one if it isn't fixed in 30 days
rules.window_note: Only if you paid for Costco México's Plan de Garantía Extendida. For computers and tablets it adds 2 years after the maker's first year, 3 years in all. Power surges are covered from the day you buy it. Commercial use isn't covered. Costco's page doesn't spell out the terms for other products, so check your plan card.
rules.what_you_get: Unlimited repairs with new parts for mechanical and electrical faults, with no deductible. If they don't fix it within 30 calendar days, you get a new one.
rules.how_to_claim: Call the plan's line on 55 5322 1961 to open a service request. You either take it to the nearest service centre, or they give you a free shipping label to send it in; they call you when it's fixed. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: My [item] has Costco's Plan de Garantía Extendida and it hasn't been fixed within 30 days, so under the plan I'd like a new one.
rules.source_quote: Si no reparamos tu producto en 30 días naturales,¡te damos uno nuevo!

rules.title: The Home Depot México gives you 60 days to return or swap
rules.window_note: 60 days from the day you bought it, at the store where you bought it. Bring the receipt or order number and the item in its original box with all its parts. Special-order items only come back if they're faulty or damaged. After 90 days from delivery, warranty claims go to the maker or its authorised service centre. Installation services and commercial sales aren't covered.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or an exchange. In-store purchases are refunded at the customer service desk; online purchases go back to the way you paid, within 7 business days depending on your bank.
rules.how_to_claim: Go to the Servicio al Cliente desk at the store where you bought it, with the receipt and the item in its box. Questions: call 800 004 6633. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] here less than 60 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like a refund or exchange under your 60-day return policy.
rules.source_quote: Se tienen 60 días a partir de la fecha de compra para realizar el reembolso o cambio de mercancía en la tienda donde se realizó la compra.

rules.title: Amazon México: 30 days to send back a faulty item
rules.window_note: 30 days from delivery for most things sold or shipped by Amazon. TVs can come back for any reason within 30 days, and a damaged or faulty one gets a free return or replacement. Phones and Apple products get only 14 days. Mattresses only come back unopened. For items sold and shipped by outside sellers, contact the seller (the A-to-z Guarantee covers you if they don't help). Amazon also suggests contacting the maker under the product's warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A refund or a replacement. For a damaged, faulty or wrong item, Amazon also refunds shipping. If it sends a replacement, return the original within 30 days or you may be charged for it.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a return in Amazon's online Returns Centre from your orders and pick the reason. Amazon gives you a prepaid label if its carrier covers your address; if not, send it tracked and email Amazon the receipt to get the postage back. Remove your personal data first. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: This [item] arrived less than 30 days ago and it's defective, so I'd like to return it under Amazon México's 30-day policy.
rules.source_quote: Puedes devolver un producto defectuoso dentro de los 30 días a partir de la fecha de entrega del pedido a través de nuestro Centro de devoluciones en línea

rules.title: Phones bought on Amazon México get 14 days, not 30
rules.window_note: 14 days from delivery, for any reason. It has to be like new, in its original box, and factory-reset with your data wiped. After that, a fault is for the maker's warranty. iPhones also follow Amazon's stricter Apple rule.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, or a free return or replacement if it arrived damaged or faulty.
rules.how_to_claim: Factory-reset the phone, then start a return in Amazon's online Returns Centre and send it back in its original box. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: This phone arrived less than 14 days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like a free return or replacement under Amazon México's 14-day phone policy.
rules.source_quote: Los celulares pueden ser devueltos por cualquier motivo dentro de los 14 días siguientes a la recepción del envío.

rules.title: Apple products on Amazon México: 14 days, and only if faulty, damaged or still sealed
rules.window_note: 14 days from delivery. Amazon only takes back Apple-brand products that didn't work on first use, arrived damaged, or are still sealed and unused. Renewed or refurbished Apple items don't follow this rule. After 14 days, a fault is for Apple's own warranty.
rules.what_you_get: A refund, processed up to 72 hours after the item reaches Amazon's warehouse. If it didn't work out of the box, Apple Support can arrange a replacement or repair instead.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a return in Amazon's online Returns Centre within 14 days. Or call Apple Support on 001-866-676-5682, which decides if it was dead on arrival and offers a replacement or repair. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: This Apple product didn't work the first time I used it and arrived less than 14 days ago, so I'd like to return it under Amazon México's Apple policy.
rules.source_quote: Si el producto cumple alguna de estas tres condiciones, entonces puedes devolverlo dentro de los 14 días posteriores a la recepción del envío

rules.title: Amazon México refunds you itself when an outside seller won't
rules.window_note: You can claim up to 90 days after the latest estimated delivery date. Ask the seller for a return first and give them 48 hours. It covers items sold and shipped by outside sellers, not Prime deliveries or Amazon International (contact Amazon directly for those). You lose it if you already disputed the charge with your bank.
rules.what_you_get: Amazon decides and refunds you. For a damaged, faulty or very different item that's the price, the original shipping and the return shipping, as long as you asked for the return within 30 days of delivery and sent it within 14 days of agreeing it with the seller.
rules.how_to_claim: From your orders, contact the seller and request a return. If 48 hours pass without them authorising it, file an A-to-z Guarantee claim with Amazon on that order. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: The seller hasn't authorised the return of my faulty item after more than 48 hours, so I'm filing an A-to-z Guarantee claim.
rules.source_quote: Y la última fecha de entrega posible de tu pedido es de 90 días o menos.

rules.title: Amazon Renewed items on Amazon México: 90 days for a replacement or refund
rules.window_note: 90 days from delivery, but only for Renewed items whose product page names the Amazon Renewed guarantee. It covers items that don't work as expected. If the return isn't Amazon's mistake or a defect, the original shipping isn't refunded.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement or a refund.
rules.how_to_claim: Start a return in Amazon's online Returns Centre and say the item doesn't work. Wipe your data first. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: This Amazon Renewed [item] stopped working within 90 days, and the Amazon Renewed guarantee on its page gives me 90 days, so I'd like a replacement or refund.
rules.source_quote: Con esta garantía, eres elegible para un reemplazo o reembolso en un plazo de 90 días a partir de la recepción del producto si no funciona como se esperaba.

rules.title: Sanborns online: electrical items with a factory fault can go back within 60 days
rules.window_note: 60 calendar days from delivery, for electrical and electronic items bought on sanborns.com.mx that have a manufacturing defect. Wrong or damaged deliveries must be reported within the first 24 hours to get a swap. No exchanges or returns on TVs, cameras, computers, tablets, AirPods, iPads and phones (the maker handles those, and Telcel handles phones), nor on video game consoles, software, watches and jewellery.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement or your money back. You say which one in the note you send with it.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it to a Sanborns store. If there's none near you, call 55 1203 0514 and Sanborns emails you a prepaid label. Pack it in the original box with the original invoice and a note saying what's wrong and whether you want a replacement or a refund. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: This [item] I bought on sanborns.com.mx has a manufacturing defect and arrived less than 60 days ago, so under your terms I'd like a replacement or a refund.
rules.source_quote: La garantía de productos eléctricos y electrónicos será válida únicamente durante los 60 días naturales a la recepción de estos.

rules.title: El Palacio de Hierro online: 30 business days to return clothes, shoes and more
rules.window_note: 30 business days (días hábiles) from the day you bought it, which is about six weeks. It must be new and in perfect condition. Many departments can't be returned at all: computers, sound and TV, phones, big and small appliances, photography, video games, furniture, watches, jewellery, accessories, perfume and cosmetics, swimwear, underwear, bedding, décor, ride-on toys and evening wear. For those, use the maker's warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Your money back: to a Palacio or credit card within 3 business days, or by cheque within 20 business days if you paid by debit card or PayPal. Shipping is only refunded if you return the whole order. You can also swap for another size or colour.
rules.how_to_claim: Call 55 5229 3154, option 1, to start the return. Small items like clothes and shoes can go to a Palacio store with a returns point; for bigger ones, ask for a courier pickup at home. If they still say no, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this on elpalaciodehierro.com less than 30 business days ago and it's faulty, so I'd like to return it under your online return policy.
rules.source_quote: Tienes hasta 30 días hábiles después de realizar tu compra.

rules.title: El Palacio de Hierro won't take back electronics or appliances bought online, so the maker's warranty is your route
rules.window_note: Phones, computers, TVs, sound, photography, video games, big and small appliances, furniture and watches can't be returned to Palacio online. The maker's warranty covers them from the moment the item is delivered and you accept it. Its length is on the warranty policy (póliza) in the box.
rules.what_you_get: A repair or replacement from the maker under its warranty. Palacio's advisers tell you how to make the claim.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Palacio on 55 5229 3154, option 1, and an adviser will guide you through the warranty claim, or contact the maker directly with the details on the póliza. Keep the receipt or invoice. If the maker refuses a valid claim, complain to Profeco, Mexico's consumer agency, on 55 5568 8722 or 800 468 8722, or at a Profeco office.
rules.script_hint: I bought this [item] on elpalaciodehierro.com and it has a fault, so I'd like your help making the maker's warranty claim, as your policy says.
rules.source_quote: Algunos artículos como celulares, computadoras o televisiones están protegidos por una garantía de fabricante, quien se hará cargo del cambio o la reparación en caso de que presenten daños físicos o de funcionamiento.

rules.title: GE appliances bought in Canada usually get 1 year of warranty repairs
rules.window_note: Usually one year, counted from the day you bought it. Your sales receipt, a letter from your builder or other proof you moved in sets that date. With no proof, GE goes by the date the appliance was made, which can leave you less time. Some models get longer coverage on certain parts, and the Owner's Manual for your model has the exact terms.
rules.what_you_get: A warranty repair on a fault your model's warranty covers. The Owner's Manual says what is covered, for how long, and which parts get extra years.
rules.how_to_claim: Have your model and serial number and your receipt ready. Book warranty service with GE Appliances Canada by phone at 1-800-561-3344 or online through the Owner's Center on geappliances.ca. If a fair claim is refused, go back to the store that sold it to you, and ask your provincial consumer protection office what else you can do.
rules.script_hint: My GE [appliance] is less than a year old and has a fault, so I'd like to book a repair under GE Appliances Canada's manufacturer's warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: GE Appliances products typically come with an initial manufacturer's warranty. The initial warranty period is typically one year.

rules.title: A repair by GE Appliances Canada's own repair team is covered for 1 year
rules.window_note: One year on a repair done by GE Appliances Canada's repair team. GE lists it as a benefit of using its own repair team, which you can book for appliances in or out of warranty. Keep the repair invoice.
rules.what_you_get: If the same repair fails, the parts and labour used in it are covered for a year, and so is the home call charge.
rules.how_to_claim: Call GE Appliances Canada at 1-800-561-3344 or email service@geappliances.ca. Give them the date of the first repair and your invoice, and say the same problem is back. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: Your repair team fixed my GE [appliance] less than a year ago and the same fault is back, so I'd like it fixed under the 1-year parts and labour warranty on that repair.
rules.source_quote: You'll get a 1-year Parts and Labour warranty used in the repair which also includes a home call charge.

rules.title: Miele appliances bought in Canada get 1 year of free parts and labour, 2 if Miele installed them
rules.window_note: One year from the day it was delivered, for home use. If Miele or an installer Miele approves put it in, you get one more year, 2 in total. You must be the first buyer, it must be bought from Miele or a Miele dealer in Canada, and it must be in Canada. Countertop coffee machines, vacuums and fridge cooling systems have their own, longer terms. Used in a business, it's 6 months.
rules.what_you_get: Miele repairs the appliance, or replaces it if it chooses, at no cost for parts or labour. If you live somewhere remote, you may have to pay the technician's travel or the cost of shipping it to a service centre.
rules.how_to_claim: Report the fault to Miele in writing (customercare@miele.ca works) inside the warranty time, with proof of your purchase date. You can also call Miele Customer Care at 1-800-565-6435. If Miele refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Miele [appliance] was delivered less than a year ago (two years, as Miele installed it) and has a fault, so I'd like a free repair under Miele Canada's limited warranty.
rules.source_quote: If the appliance is installed by Miele or an authorized Miele installer, the Miele appliance warranty is extended by one additional year (for a total of 2 years)

rules.title: Miele fridges, freezers and wine coolers in Canada: the cooling system is covered for 10 years
rules.window_note: Years 1 to 5 from the day you bought it: the sealed cooling system is repaired for free, parts and labour. Years 6 to 10: the parts are free but you pay Miele's usual labour charge. The sealed system means the compressor, condenser, evaporator, drier, the original refrigerant and the tubing that links them. You must be the first buyer and have bought it from Miele or a Miele dealer in Canada.
rules.what_you_get: A free repair or replacement of a faulty compressor or other sealed-system part for 10 years. The first 5 years include labour.
rules.how_to_claim: Report the fault to Miele in writing (customercare@miele.ca) with proof of your purchase date, or call Miele Customer Care at 1-800-565-6435. Say it is the sealed refrigeration system. If Miele refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Miele fridge has stopped cooling because of a fault in the sealed system, and it is less than 10 years old, so the parts should be covered under Miele Canada's sealed-system warranty.
rules.source_quote: If a claim regarding a defect in material or workmanship relating to the Sealed Refrigeration Systems used in Miele Refrigerators, Wine Coolers, and Freezers is received by Miele within five (5) years from the date of purchase

rules.title: Miele countertop coffee machines bought in Canada since 2024 get 2 years
rules.window_note: Two years from the day it was delivered, parts and labour, for countertop coffee machines bought on or after January 1, 2024. Ones bought before then have 1 year. You must be the first buyer and have bought it from Miele or a Miele dealer in Canada. Used in a business, it's 6 months.
rules.what_you_get: Miele repairs the machine, or replaces it if it chooses, at no cost for parts or labour.
rules.how_to_claim: Report the fault to Miele in writing (customercare@miele.ca) with proof of your purchase date, or call Miele Customer Care at 1-800-565-6435. If Miele refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Miele coffee machine was bought after January 1, 2024 and has a fault within two years, so I'd like a free repair under Miele Canada's 2-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: All CM purchases made on or after January 1, 2024 are eligible for a 2-year warranty.

rules.title: Miele vacuums in Canada: 1 year on the vacuum, 7 years on the Vortex motor
rules.window_note: The whole vacuum (upright, cordless stick or canister) is covered for 1 year from delivery. The Vortex motor is covered for 7 years, except on S170 to S189 uprights, where the motor gets 2 years. Varta or Huizhou Blueway batteries in cordless sticks get 2 years. All of it is parts and labour, for home use. Using non-Miele bags or filters can void it.
rules.what_you_get: Miele repairs the vacuum, or replaces it if it chooses, at no cost for parts or labour.
rules.how_to_claim: Report the fault to Miele in writing (customercare@miele.ca) with proof of your purchase date, or call Miele Customer Care at 1-800-565-6435. Miele may have you take it to a Miele dealer or service centre. If Miele refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Miele vacuum's Vortex motor has failed and it is less than 7 years old, so I'd like it repaired free under Miele Canada's motor warranty.
rules.source_quote: Seven (7) years, VortexTM motor for canister, cordless stick and upright units

rules.title: Samsung fridges, washers, dryers, ranges, microwaves and dishwashers in Canada get 12 months of free in-home repair
rules.window_note: 12 months from the day the first buyer bought it, parts and labour, with a technician coming to your home. Some parts get longer: 10 years on fridge compressors and washer motors, 5 years on microwave magnetrons and some glass cooktops. It only covers products bought in Canada. Using a home appliance in a business, a bad install, or a removed serial number cancels it.
rules.what_you_get: Samsung repairs a manufacturing defect for free, parts and labour, at your home.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Samsung Canada at 1-800-SAMSUNG (1-800-726-7864) with your model number, serial number and purchase date to book an in-home repair. If Samsung refuses a fair claim, ask the store that sold it to you, then your provincial consumer protection office.
rules.script_hint: My Samsung [appliance] is less than 12 months old and has a fault, so I'd like to book a free in-home repair under Samsung Canada's 12-month parts and labour warranty.
rules.source_quote: All Dishwashers have 12 months parts and labour warranty

rules.title: Samsung fridges in Canada: the digital inverter compressor is covered for 10 years
rules.window_note: 10 years from the day the first buyer bought it, for the part only. After the first 12 months, labour is not included, so you may pay for the technician's time. Your manual or warranty card says if your model has any other extra parts coverage. Bought outside Canada, it's not covered.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement digital inverter compressor if yours fails.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Samsung Canada at 1-800-SAMSUNG (1-800-726-7864) with your model number, serial number and purchase date, and say the compressor has failed. Ask what the labour will cost before you book. If Samsung refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Samsung fridge's digital inverter compressor has failed and the fridge is under 10 years old, so the part is covered by Samsung Canada's 10-year compressor warranty.
rules.source_quote: All Refrigerators have 12-month parts and labour warranty, with 10-year parts warranty on digital inverter compressors.

rules.title: Samsung washers in Canada: the digital inverter motor is covered for 10 years
rules.window_note: 10 years from the day the first buyer bought it, for the motor part only. After the first 12 months, labour is not included. Some direct-drive models get extra parts coverage, which your manual or warranty card lists. Bought outside Canada, it's not covered.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement digital inverter motor if yours fails.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Samsung Canada at 1-800-SAMSUNG (1-800-726-7864) with your model number, serial number and purchase date, and say the motor has failed. Ask what the labour will cost before you book. If Samsung refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Samsung washer's digital inverter motor has failed and the washer is under 10 years old, so the part is covered by Samsung Canada's 10-year motor warranty.
rules.source_quote: All washing machines have 12 months parts and labour warranty, with 10-year parts warranty on digital inverter motor.

rules.title: Samsung over-the-range microwaves and some ranges in Canada get 5 years on key parts
rules.window_note: 5 years from the day the first buyer bought it, parts only. Over-the-range microwaves: the magnetron (the part that makes the heat). Ranges FE710, NE595R1 and NE597R0: the radiant heater and glass cooktop. Ranges NE595N0, NE597N0 and NE599N1: the glass cooktop. After the first 12 months, labour is not included.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement of the magnetron, radiant heater or glass cooktop if it fails.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Samsung Canada at 1-800-SAMSUNG (1-800-726-7864) with your model number, serial number and purchase date. Ask what the labour will cost before you book. If Samsung refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Samsung over-the-range microwave's magnetron has failed within 5 years, so the part is covered by Samsung Canada's 5-year magnetron warranty.
rules.source_quote: All OTR Microwave Ovens have 12-month parts and labour warranty, with 5-year parts warranty on the magnetron.

rules.title: Samsung vacuums in Canada get 12 months, battery included
rules.window_note: 12 months from the day the first buyer bought it, and the battery is covered for the same 12 months. Only products bought in Canada are covered.
rules.what_you_get: Samsung repairs a manufacturing defect for free. You bring it in to a service centre or Samsung arranges a pickup.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Samsung Canada at 1-800-SAMSUNG (1-800-726-7864) with your model number, serial number and purchase date, and ask for carry-in or pickup service. If Samsung refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Samsung vacuum is less than 12 months old and the [battery / motor] has failed, so I'd like it repaired free under Samsung Canada's 12-month warranty.
rules.source_quote: Twelve (12) months for Battery

rules.title: Dyson cordless vacuums, fans, purifiers and hair tools in Canada get 2 years
rules.window_note: Two years from the day you bought it or the day it was delivered, whichever is later. That covers cordless vacuums, fans and heaters, purifiers and humidifiers, hair dryers, stylers and straighteners, and audio. Keep your receipt and delivery note: with no proof, Dyson starts the clock 90 days after the machine was made. Time your machine spends being repaired is added on. Refurbished machines have their own terms.
rules.what_you_get: Dyson fixes it for free, all parts and labour, or replaces it. It does not cover wear parts like the clear bin, filter, brush bar and cord, or a battery that just holds less charge with age.
rules.how_to_claim: Call the Dyson Helpline at 1-866-693-9766 (or use live chat on dysoncanada.ca) with your model, serial number, and the date and place you bought it. Dyson or its agent does the work. If Dyson refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Dyson [machine] developed a fault less than two years after I bought it, so I'd like it repaired free under the Dyson 2-year limited warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Your Dyson machine is covered by a warranty against original defects in materials and workmanship for two or five years, depending on the product, starting from the date of purchase, or date of delivery (whichever is later)

rules.title: Dyson corded vacuums, hand dryers and lights in Canada get 5 years
rules.window_note: Five years from the day you bought it or the day it was delivered, whichever is later. Keep your receipt and delivery note: with no proof, Dyson starts the clock 90 days after the machine was made. Time your machine spends being repaired is added on.
rules.what_you_get: Dyson fixes it for free, all parts and labour, or replaces it. Wear parts like the clear bin, filter, brush bar and cord, and clearing blockages, are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Call the Dyson Helpline at 1-866-693-9766 (or use live chat on dysoncanada.ca) with your model, serial number, and the date and place you bought it. If Dyson refuses, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My corded Dyson vacuum developed a fault less than five years after I bought it, so I'd like it repaired free under the Dyson 5-year limited warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Your Dyson machine is covered by a warranty against original defects in materials and workmanship for two or five years, depending on the product, starting from the date of purchase, or date of delivery (whichever is later)

rules.title: In Canada, fixing your Dyson at an independent shop does not cancel its warranty
rules.window_note: Lasts as long as your Dyson warranty: 2 years for cordless vacuums, fans, purifiers and hair tools, 5 years for corded vacuums, hand dryers and lights.
rules.what_you_get: You can pay any repair shop, or use parts not made by Dyson, and the rest of your warranty still stands. Dyson just won't pay for damage caused by that outside repair or those parts.
rules.how_to_claim: If Dyson says your warranty is void because someone else repaired it, point to this line in the Dyson Canada limited warranty and ask them to deal with the fault that has nothing to do with that repair. Call the Dyson Helpline at 1-866-693-9766.
rules.script_hint: Dyson Canada's limited warranty says an independent repair or third-party parts will not void it, so please handle this fault, which isn't related to that repair, under my warranty.
rules.source_quote: You may also choose to have your product repaired (at your own cost) through another repair shop that is not affiliated with or an authorized dealer of Dyson and doing so will not void this warranty

rules.title: Shark upright and cordless vacuums sold in Canada usually get 5 years
rules.window_note: Five years from the day you bought it on the models that carry it, such as the Navigator NV380C and DetectPro LA802C uprights and the PowerDetect IP1251C cordless stick on sharkninja.ca. Handheld vacuums such as the CH700C list 2 years, and robot vacuums such as the RV2610WDCA and AV2511AE list only 1 year. The length is on the product page and in your Owner's Guide. First owner only, bought from an authorized seller, and not bought or used outside North America. Filters and brushrolls wear out and are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: SharkNinja repairs or replaces the faulty vacuum or parts. A replacement is covered for 6 months or the rest of your original warranty, whichever is later, and days SharkNinja has your vacuum are added on.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact SharkNinja Canada through the Contact Us page on support.sharkninja.ca to start a warranty claim. Have your receipt and model number ready. Outside Quebec a shipping fee may apply to a replacement; in Quebec you pay the cost of shipping it. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Shark vacuum stopped working less than five years after I bought it, and its product page lists a five-year limited warranty, so I'd like to start a warranty claim; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: SharkNinja warrants that the unit shall be free from defects in material and workmanship for a period of five (5) years from the date of purchase when it is used under normal household conditions

rules.title: Ninja kitchen appliances sold in Canada usually get 1 year
rules.window_note: Usually one year from the day you bought it; for example the Ninja Air Fryer Pro AF141C on sharkninja.ca lists a one-year limited warranty. SharkNinja also uses 2, 3, 5 and 7-year warranties, and the length is on each product page and in your Owner's Guide. First owner only, bought from an authorized seller, used at home in North America. Blades, removable pots, racks and filters wear out and are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: SharkNinja repairs or replaces the faulty unit or parts. A replacement is covered for 6 months or the rest of your original warranty, whichever is later.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact SharkNinja Canada through the Contact Us page on support.sharkninja.ca to start a warranty claim. Have your receipt, model and serial number ready. Outside Quebec a shipping fee may apply to a replacement; in Quebec you pay the cost of shipping it. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Ninja [item] stopped working less than a year after I bought it and I have my receipt, so I'd like to start a warranty claim for a repair or replacement.
rules.source_quote: SharkNinja warrants that the unit shall be free from defects in material and workmanship for a period of one (1) year from the date of purchase when it is used under normal household conditions

rules.title: Cuisinart coffee makers sold in Canada usually get 3 years
rules.window_note: Three years from the day you first bought it, for home use. That is the term in Cuisinart Canada's DCC-1200C coffee maker booklet. Other Cuisinart appliances have their own length, printed in the booklet that came in the box. Register it at cuisinart.ca and keep your receipt for as long as the warranty lasts. Not for stores or business buyers.
rules.what_you_get: Cuisinart repairs it, or replaces it if needed. Scratches, stains and other marks that don't stop it working are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Don't take it back to the store. Call Cuisinart Canada at 1-800-472-7606 (or email Consumer_Canada@Conair.com). If they ask you to send it in, include $10.00 for shipping and handling (cheque or money order), your return address and phone number, what's wrong, and the date code or a copy of your receipt. Use a tracked, insured service, since Cuisinart won't cover loss in transit.
rules.script_hint: My Cuisinart coffee maker stopped working less than three years after I bought it, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under the limited three-year warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: We warrant that this Cuisinart product will be free of defects in material or workmanship under normal home use for 3 years from the date of original purchase.

rules.title: Cuisinart cookware sold in Canada is covered for as long as you live
rules.window_note: For the rest of your life as the first buyer, counted from the day you bought it. Keep your original receipt: registering at cuisinart.ca does not replace it.
rules.what_you_get: Cuisinart repairs it, or replaces it if it thinks that's needed, free except a $10.00 shipping and handling fee. Scratches, stains, colour changes, overheating damage and marks that don't stop it cooking are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Cuisinart Canada at 1-800-472-7606 or email Consumer_Canada@Conair.com. If you send it in, include $10.00 by cheque or money order to Cuisinart Canada, your receipt, return address, phone number and what's wrong. Use a tracked, insured service, since lost or damaged parcels aren't covered.
rules.script_hint: My Cuisinart pan has a defect in the material or the making, and Cuisinart Canada's limited lifetime warranty covers that for the original buyer, so I'd like it repaired or replaced; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Your Cuisinart® Cookware is warranted to be free of defects in material and workmanship with normal home use from the date of original purchase throughout the original purchaser’s lifetime.

rules.title: Cuisinart knives sold in Canada are covered for as long as you live
rules.window_note: For the rest of your life as the first buyer, counted from the day you bought it. Keep your original receipt: registering at cuisinart.ca does not replace it.
rules.what_you_get: Cuisinart repairs the knife, or replaces it if it thinks that's needed, free except a $5.00 shipping and handling fee. Scratches, stains, small flaws and overheating damage are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Call Cuisinart Canada at 1-800-472-7606 or email Consumer_Canada@Conair.com. If you send it in, include $5.00 by cheque or money order, your receipt, return address, phone number and what's wrong. Use a tracked, insured service.
rules.script_hint: My Cuisinart knife has a defect in the material or the making, and Cuisinart's limited lifetime warranty covers the original buyer, so I'd like it repaired or replaced; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Your CuisinartTM Cutlery is warranted to be free of defects in material and workmanship under normal home use from the date of original purchase throughout the original purchaser’s lifetime.

rules.title: Le Creuset cast iron, stainless steel and metal bakeware bought in Canada are covered for life
rules.window_note: For as long as you own it, from the day it was bought. That covers enamelled cast iron, stainless steel, Toughened Nonstick Pro and metal bakeware. It only covers pieces bought in Canada from Le Creuset or a seller it approves, for home use. It can be claimed by the first buyer, or by someone who got it new as a gift from them. Keep your receipt.
rules.what_you_get: Le Creuset repairs or replaces a piece with a manufacturing defect free of charge, but you pay the cost of sending it back to Le Creuset or the store. Wear and tear, scratches, stains, colour changes, corrosion, glass lids and damage from misuse are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Fill in the warranty form at lecreuset.ca/warranty-inquiry, and Le Creuset's customer service team will contact you with next steps. Have your receipt ready, and expect to pay to send the piece back. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Le Creuset [piece] has a manufacturing defect and Le Creuset Canada's limited lifetime warranty covers it, so I'd like it repaired or replaced; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Le Creuset provides this limited warranty for Cast Iron for the lifetime of the purchaser, for as long as the purchaser owns the product or receives the product as a gift, starting from the date of purchase.

rules.title: Le Creuset stoneware bought in Canada is covered for 10 years
rules.window_note: 10 years from the day it was bought. Le Creuset pepper and salt mills and metal wine tools also get 10 years; knives get 2. It only covers pieces bought in Canada from Le Creuset or a seller it approves, for home use. It can be claimed by the first buyer, or by someone who got it new as a gift from them. Keep your receipt.
rules.what_you_get: Le Creuset repairs or replaces a piece with a manufacturing defect free of charge, but you pay the cost of sending it back to Le Creuset or the store. Wear and tear, scratches, stains, colour changes and damage from misuse are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Fill in the warranty form at lecreuset.ca/warranty-inquiry, and Le Creuset's customer service team will contact you with next steps. Have your receipt ready, and expect to pay to send the piece back. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Le Creuset stoneware dish has a manufacturing defect and it's less than 10 years old, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under Le Creuset Canada's 10-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: Le Creuset provides this warranty for Stoneware product for a period of 10 years from the date of purchase

rules.title: Le Creuset enamel-on-steel kettles and stockpots bought in Canada get 5 years
rules.window_note: 5 years from the day it was bought. Silicone tools get 5 years too. It only covers pieces bought in Canada from Le Creuset or a seller it approves, for home use. It can be claimed by the first buyer, or by someone who got it new as a gift from them. Keep your receipt.
rules.what_you_get: Le Creuset repairs or replaces a piece with a manufacturing defect free of charge, but you pay the cost of sending it back to Le Creuset or the store. Wear and tear, scratches, stains, colour changes, corrosion and damage from misuse are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Fill in the warranty form at lecreuset.ca/warranty-inquiry, and Le Creuset's customer service team will contact you with next steps. Have your receipt ready, and expect to pay to send the piece back. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Le Creuset kettle has a manufacturing defect and it's less than 5 years old, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under Le Creuset Canada's 5-year warranty.
rules.source_quote: Le Creuset provides this warranty for the Enamel on Steel Kettle product for a period of 5 years from the date of purchase

rules.title: Zwilling Canada replaces faulty knives and cookware, with no end date given
rules.window_note: Zwilling Canada's warranty page gives no time limit, unless the product's packaging states a shorter one. Not covered: normal wear, chipped or broken knife tips, anything with wooden parts (like knife handles or cutting boards), accidents, misuse and business use.
rules.what_you_get: A free replacement of the faulty item, or a similar one if it's no longer made. Zwilling does not repair anything, and the item you send in is recycled, not returned.
rules.how_to_claim: Since August 1, 2026, warranty claims must go through Zwilling's online Support Center, and stores no longer take them. Customer service can also help at 1-800-775-6020 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern). Have your name, order number, product number, billing address and a photo. If they approve it, they email a Return Authorization (RA) number; put it in the box and ship it insured with tracking at your own cost. Wrap knife points and edges so they can't cut through.
rules.script_hint: My Zwilling [item] has a defect in the material or the making, which Zwilling Canada's warranty covers, so I'd like an RA number for a replacement.
rules.source_quote: You will be pleased to know that all our products are fully guaranteed against defects in materials and / or craftsmanship.

rules.title: Victorinox Swiss Army knives and kitchen knives are covered for the life of the knife
rules.window_note: For the lifetime of the product, from the day it was first bought. That covers knives, cutlery and tableware, sharpening tools and kitchen utensils such as cutting boards. Electronic parts, accessories like pouches and knife blocks, small leather goods, and brand-collection or other brands' products get 2 years instead. It only applies if you bought it from Victorinox or an authorized Victorinox seller. Keep your receipt.
rules.what_you_get: Victorinox or one of its service centres repairs or replaces it, and pays to ship it back to you. Repairs restore how it works, not always how it looks, and Victorinox may charge a handling fee. Normal wear and tear, cosmetic damage, and damage from misuse or accidents are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact Victorinox, the authorized seller you bought it from, or your closest Victorinox service centre (use the Store Finder on victorinox.com), or call Victorinox customer support at 1-800-442-2706. You either ship the knife to Victorinox or the seller, or take it to a service centre, with your receipt. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My Victorinox knife has a defect in the material or the making, which the Victorinox lifetime warranty covers, so I'd like it repaired or replaced; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Victorinox AG warrants to the end-user purchaser that the Victorinox product will be free from material or manufacturer defects that appear during the course of normal use of the product for the lifetime of the product

rules.title: Victorinox luggage and bags bought in Canada since October 2024 are covered for life, even for airline damage
rules.window_note: For the lifetime of the product, on business cases, duffle bags, totes, wheeled luggage and backpacks bought in Canada or the US on or after October 1, 2024. Journey backpacks get 3 years, and small leather goods and accessories get 2. Bags bought before October 1, 2024 are not covered by this lifetime warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Victorinox or one of its service centres repairs or replaces it, and pays to ship it back to you. It covers faults from normal wear and tear and damage done by an airline. It does not cover scratches, dents, scuffs, stains or fading, lost or stolen bags, or accidents and misuse.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact Victorinox at consumerinquiries.us@victorinox.com or 1-800-442-2706 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern), or your nearest Victorinox service centre. You ship the bag to a service centre in Canada or the US; Victorinox pays the return shipping.
rules.script_hint: My Victorinox [bag] was bought after October 1, 2024 and the [wheel / handle / zipper] has failed, which the Victorinox Travel Gear Lifetime Warranty covers, including airline damage, so I'd like it repaired.
rules.source_quote: for the lifetime of the product, including functional defects due to normal wear and tear and damages incurred by an airline

rules.title: IKEA SEKTION kitchens in Canada are covered for 25 years
rules.window_note: 25 years from the day you bought it for SEKTION cabinet frames, doors, drawer fronts, MAXIMERA drawers, UTRUSTA hinges and shelves, legs, cover panels, pre-cut countertops and sinks. UTRUSTA wire baskets and TORNVIKEN and VADHOLMA get 10 years, the UTRUSTA push-opener 5. ENHET kitchens and all kitchen faucets get 10 years, KNOXHULT 5. Not covered: custom countertops, wall panels, knobs, handles, FYNDIG sinks. Moving or reinstalling the kitchen ends the warranty. The first buyer's receipt is the proof of purchase, and the warranty doesn't pass to a new owner (except in Saskatchewan). Home use only.
rules.what_you_get: IKEA repairs the faulty part or replaces it with the same or a similar one, and pays for parts, labour and the repair person's travel.
rules.how_to_claim: Call IKEA Canada at 1-866-866-4532 or start a claim on IKEA.ca, with your original receipt. IKEA looks at the product and decides. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My IKEA SEKTION [door / drawer / hinge] has a defect and it's under 25 years old, so it's covered by IKEA's 25-year kitchen warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: The limited warranty for the SEKTION kitchen system is valid for twenty-five (25) years from the date of purchase.

rules.title: IKEA kitchen appliances bought in Canada get 5 years of free in-home repair
rules.window_note: 5 years from the day you bought it. TILLREDA and LAGAN appliances get 2 years. Scratches, dents or chips count only if you report them within 7 days of buying or delivery. Food that spoils, bulbs and filters, and install mistakes are not covered. Keep proof of the date you bought it. It only works in the country where you bought it.
rules.what_you_get: A designated service company repairs it in your home, and the parts, labour and travel are covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Call IKEA Canada at 1-866-866-4532 or go to IKEA.ca, with your order number, receipt number, article number and the model and serial number from the appliance's rating plate. For TILLREDA you can also go to your local IKEA store. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My IKEA [appliance] is less than 5 years old and has a fault, so I'd like a free in-home repair under IKEA's 5-year appliance warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: This limited warranty is valid for five (5) years from the date of purchase. TILLREDA and LAGAN appliances have a two (2) year limited warranty

rules.title: IKEA mattresses bought in Canada are covered for 10 years
rules.window_note: 10 years from the day you bought it. Toppers, sofa-bed mattresses and children's mattresses are not covered. The first buyer's receipt is the proof of purchase, and the warranty doesn't pass to a new owner (except in Saskatchewan). Home use only.
rules.what_you_get: IKEA repairs it or replaces it with the same or a similar mattress, and pays for parts, labour and travel. It covers split seams, damaged springs, broken handles, a broken mattress base and bad sagging.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact your local IKEA store (addresses and phone numbers are on IKEA.ca) with your original receipt. IKEA looks at the mattress and decides. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My IKEA mattress is sagging badly and it's under 10 years old, so it's covered by IKEA's 10-year mattress warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: The limited warranty for mattresses remains in force for ten (10) years and is valid from the date of purchase.

rules.title: IKEA sofas and armchairs bought in Canada are covered for 10 years, some for 25
rules.window_note: 10 years from the day you bought it, and 25 years on some seating (IKEA's page names STOCKHOLM sofas). It covers the frame and the seat and back cushions of sofas, armchairs, sofa-beds and footstools. Not covered: fabric or leather covers, POÄNG cushions, rattan or other natural-fibre seats, some recliners, pouffes. The first buyer's receipt is the proof of purchase, and the warranty doesn't pass to a new owner (except in Saskatchewan). Home use only.
rules.what_you_get: IKEA repairs it or replaces it with the same or a similar piece, and pays for parts, labour and the repair person's travel.
rules.how_to_claim: Contact IKEA Canada customer service or your local store with your original receipt. IKEA looks at the piece and decides. If they refuse, ask your provincial consumer protection office what you can do.
rules.script_hint: My IKEA sofa frame has broken and it's under 10 years old, so it's covered by IKEA's seating warranty; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: we can offer you a Limited 10-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship that covers our sofas, armchairs, sofa-beds, and footstools.

rules.title: BowFlex SelectTech dumbbells sold in Canada get 2 or 3 years on parts
rules.window_note: Parts are covered for 2 years on Results Series 552 and 52 dumbbells, and 3 years on 1090 and 90, as listed on bowflex.ca. Using them in a gym or other business voids the warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Free replacement parts for a fault.
rules.how_to_claim: Call BowFlex In-Warranty Product Support at (800) 605-3369 (Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Central) with your serial number and receipt, or send a ticket through help.bowflex.com.
rules.script_hint: My BowFlex SelectTech dumbbell has a faulty [part] and it's inside the parts warranty listed on bowflex.ca, so I'd like the part replaced free.
rules.source_quote: Warranty Parts - 2 Years

rules.title: BowFlex C6 bike sold in Canada: 10 years on the frame, 3 on parts and electronics
rules.window_note: Frame 10 years, mechanical parts 3 years, electronics 3 years, labour 1 year, as listed on bowflex.ca. After the first year, parts are still covered but labour is not. Using it in a gym or other business voids the warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Free parts for 3 years (the frame for 10), and free labour in the first year.
rules.how_to_claim: Call BowFlex In-Warranty Product Support at (800) 605-3369 (Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Central) with your serial number and receipt, or send a ticket through help.bowflex.com.
rules.script_hint: My BowFlex C6 bike has a faulty [part] and it's inside the 3-year parts warranty listed on bowflex.ca, so I'd like the part replaced free.
rules.source_quote: Frame 10 Years Mechanical Parts 3 Years Electronics 3 Years Labor 1 Year

rules.title: Giant, Liv and Momentum bike frames bought in Canada have no time limit for the first owner
rules.window_note: No time limit on the frame for the first owner (downhill frames get 3 years). Rigid forks get 10 years, Giant-brand parts 2 years, e-bike electronics 2 years, e-bike batteries 2 years or 600 charges, paint and decals 1 year. Pedals, grips, bar tape and saddle get 1 year, or 2 if you registered the bike. It applies to bikes from 2012 on, bought new from and put together by a Giant dealer or Giant's online store. Other brands' parts, like Shimano or SRAM, follow their own maker's warranty.
rules.what_you_get: Giant replaces the faulty part with one of equal or better value. Giant's help page says approved claims include the labour and shipping for that part, but its exclusions list labour for swapping parts, so confirm with the shop before work starts. Normal wear, corrosion, crashes, racing and shop work by a non-Giant dealer are not covered.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the bike and your proof of purchase to a Giant dealer, ideally the one that sold it. They must see the bike in person; photos won't do. If the shop won't help, contact Giant Canada.
rules.script_hint: My Giant frame has cracked with no crash, and Giant gives the first owner a lifetime frame warranty, so please file a claim; here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: Giant warrants for the original owner under limited conditions that the frame, rigid fork, original component parts, rider gear or service gear of each new Giant product (Giant, Liv, Momentum) including E-bikes and Giant brand framesets

rules.title: A registered Giant bike in Canada keeps up to 2 years of warranty for its second owner
rules.window_note: Only if the first owner registered the bike on Giant's website within 90 days of buying it. The time counts from the first owner's purchase date: 2 years on the frame, rigid fork, Giant-brand parts, pedals, grips, bar tape, saddle and e-bike electronics, 1 year on other parts. Only the second owner is covered, not later ones, and other brands' parts are not included. For bikes bought new between August 1, 2022 and June 1, 2024, the frame gets 2 years from the day the second owner bought it (rigid forks up to 10 years from the first purchase).
rules.what_you_get: Giant replaces the faulty part with one of equal or better value, through a Giant dealer.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the bike to a Giant dealer with the first owner's original receipt and proof that you bought it from them. The dealer checks it in person and files the claim.
rules.script_hint: I'm the second owner of this Giant bike, the first owner registered it within 90 days, and here is their receipt and my proof of sale, so the second-owner warranty should cover this [frame / part] fault.
rules.source_quote: registered bicycles will have the warranty extended to the second owner (other successive owners are not included and non-Giant branded components are not included)

rules.title: Makita Canada: 3 years on lithium-ion tools, batteries and chargers
rules.window_note: Three years from the day you first bought it. This covers Makita lithium-ion tools, batteries and chargers, Makita pneumatic nailers and staplers, and Makita lithium-ion outdoor power equipment. For nailers, staplers, batteries and chargers, the 3 years only counts if you bought them in Canada after April 1, 2018. Flashlights, work lights, jobsite radios, speakers, jackets and vests, and power or battery adapters only get 1 year. So do accessories that came in the box with a nailer or outdoor tool. Using a non-Makita battery cancels the warranty on lithium-ion tools and chargers.
rules.what_you_get: If Makita's inspection finds a fault in the materials or the way it was made, Makita repairs or replaces it, whichever it chooses. Not covered: normal wear and tear, abuse, misuse or poor upkeep, changes you made, or repairs someone else did or tried.
rules.how_to_claim: Send or take the complete product, freight prepaid, to a Makita factory service centre or authorized service centre in Canada. Call Makita Canada at 1-800-263-3734 to find the nearest one. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: This Makita lithium-ion [tool] was bought in Canada less than three years ago and it has a defect, not wear, so it's covered by Makita's limited three-year warranty. Please repair or replace it.
rules.source_quote: All Makita lithium ion products, lithium ion batteries and lithium ion battery chargers are warranted to be free of defects from workmanship and materials for a period of THREE YEARS from the date of original purchase.

rules.title: Makita Canada: 1 year on corded tools and everything without a longer warranty
rules.window_note: One year from the day you first bought it. This covers any Makita tool bought in Canada from an authorized dealer that doesn't get a longer warranty, such as corded tools. It also covers the lithium-ion items Makita leaves off its 3-year list: flashlights, work lights, jobsite radios, speakers, jackets and vests, and power or battery adapters. Nailer wear parts get 1 year too: piston and driver assemblies, piston cushions and stoppers, driver blades, O-rings, seals and air filters.
rules.what_you_get: If Makita's inspection finds a fault in the materials or the way it was made, Makita repairs or replaces it, whichever it chooses. Not covered: normal wear and tear, abuse, misuse or poor upkeep, changes you made, or repairs someone else did or tried.
rules.how_to_claim: Send or take the complete product, freight prepaid, to a Makita factory service centre or authorized service centre in Canada. Call Makita Canada at 1-800-263-3734 to find the nearest one. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: I bought this Makita [tool] from an authorized dealer in Canada less than a year ago and it has a defect, so it's covered by Makita's limited one-year warranty. Please repair or replace it.
rules.source_quote: All Makita tools purchased in Canada from authorized dealers are warranted to be free of defects from workmanship and materials for a period of ONE YEAR from the date of original purchase.

rules.title: Makita Canada: 2 years on gas-powered outdoor equipment
rules.window_note: Two years from the day you first bought it, for Makita gas-powered outdoor power equipment. It still counts if the machine was used for consumer, commercial or rental work. Gas-powered compressors are not included. Accessories that came in the box only get 1 year.
rules.what_you_get: If Makita's inspection finds a fault in the materials or the way it was made, Makita repairs or replaces it, whichever it chooses. Not covered: normal wear and tear, abuse, misuse or poor upkeep, changes you made, or repairs someone else did or tried.
rules.how_to_claim: Send or take the complete product, freight prepaid, to a Makita factory service centre or authorized service centre in Canada. Call Makita Canada at 1-800-263-3734 to find the nearest one. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: My Makita gas [trimmer] is less than two years old and failed because of a defect, so it's covered by Makita's limited two-year outdoor power equipment warranty. Please repair or replace it.
rules.source_quote: All Makita gas powered OPE tools shall be warranted to be free of defects from workmanship and materials for a period of TWO YEARS from the date of original purchase (excludes gas powered compressors).

rules.title: STANLEY replaces any mechanics tool that fails, for life, with no receipt needed
rules.window_note: For life, and you don't need proof of purchase. This is STANLEY's full lifetime warranty on its mechanics tools. It doesn't pay for knock-on costs caused by the failure.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement tool. STANLEY says it will replace any mechanics tool that ever fails, for any reason.
rules.how_to_claim: Call STANLEY's warranty line at 1-800-567-7188 and ask where to send the tool. STANLEY's Canadian return address for hand tools is Stanley Black & Decker, 6275 Millcreek Drive, Mississauga, ON L5N 7K6, Attn: Quality Assurance. If they refuse, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: This STANLEY mechanics tool failed. Your full lifetime warranty says you'll replace it for any reason with no proof of purchase, so I'd like a replacement.
rules.source_quote: If any STANLEY Mechanics Tool ever fails for any reason, STANLEY will replace it. NO PROOF OF PURCHASE required.

rules.title: STANLEY hand tools and tape measures are covered for their useful life
rules.window_note: For the useful life of the tool, with no set number of years. Anything with electrical or electronic parts is capped at 1 year. Not covered: knife blades, glue sticks and other things that get used up, and tools that were misused, abused, altered or repaired. Tape measures that are simply worn out from long, heavy use aren't covered either.
rules.what_you_get: If STANLEY finds a fault in the materials or the way it was made, it sends you a replacement or repairs the tool.
rules.how_to_claim: Mail the tool to Stanley Black & Decker, 6275 Millcreek Drive, Mississauga, ON L5N 7K6, Attn: Quality Assurance. For tape measures, or if you're not sure, call STANLEY at 1-800-567-7188 first. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: This STANLEY [tool] has a defect in materials or workmanship, so it's covered by STANLEY's limited lifetime warranty. Please send me a replacement.
rules.source_quote: warrants this product for its useful life (not to exceed one year for products with electrical or electronic components) against deficiencies in material and workmanship.

rules.title: STANLEY lasers: 2 years of cover and a 30-day money-back guarantee
rules.window_note: Two years against faults in materials and workmanship, for STANLEY lasers and laser distance measurers. You can also return a STANLEY laser within 30 days of buying it, for any reason, with the receipt, for a full refund. Lasers that were misused, abused, altered or repaired are not covered.
rules.what_you_get: STANLEY repairs it for free, parts and labour included. Or it may replace it, or refund the price minus an amount for depreciation. Within the first 30 days, you get a full refund if you're not happy with it.
rules.how_to_claim: Call STANLEY at 1-800-567-7188 for return instructions. Keep your receipt, because you need it for the 30-day refund. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: My STANLEY laser is less than two years old and has a defect, so I'd like it repaired or replaced under STANLEY's two-year limited warranty.
rules.source_quote: warrants this product for a period of (2) years against deficiencies in material and workmanship.

rules.title: Stanley bottles, tumblers and food jars are covered for life in Canada
rules.window_note: For the life of the product, on stainless-steel drinkware and food containers. Lids, seals and straws aren't part of the lifetime cover, and neither is any part that isn't stainless steel. It only counts for items bought from Stanley or an authorized seller.
rules.what_you_get: Stanley repairs it, or replaces it at its cost with a similar product it makes now. A product that stops keeping drinks hot or cold counts. Not covered: scratches, dents and marks from use, accidents, fires, not following the care instructions, and changes like engraving. A replacement may be a different colour, and custom artwork can't be copied onto it.
rules.how_to_claim: Fill in Stanley's online warranty claim form. They may ask for proof of purchase, photos or video, or for the item itself, so keep it until the claim is done. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: My Stanley [bottle] has stopped keeping drinks hot or cold, and that's covered by Stanley's stainless steel lifetime warranty, so I'd like a repair or replacement.
rules.source_quote: The warranty on our drinkware and food containers (not including lids, seals and straws) will last the life of the product.

rules.title: Craftsman Canada swaps a broken hand tool for a new one, for any reason, with no receipt
rules.window_note: Forever, and you don't need proof of purchase. It covers hand tools (hammers and demolition tools, finishing tools, hex keys, knives and multi-tools, nut drivers, pliers, ratchets and sockets, screwdrivers, wrenches) and mechanics tools and sets. Older models starting with 9 get the same deal as the new CMHT and CMMT ones. Levels, staplers, mitre boxes, tape measures, lasers and stud finders only have a limited lifetime warranty. For those, it must be a real defect, you need proof of purchase, and the warranty can't be passed on.
rules.what_you_get: A replacement tool. Craftsman says that if the tool fails to perform for any reason, it will replace it.
rules.how_to_claim: Take the broken tool to a store that stocks Craftsman and ask for a warranty swap, or contact Craftsman Customer Care through craftsman.ca. Don't throw the broken tool away. If they refuse, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: This Craftsman hand tool failed, and Craftsman's full lifetime warranty says it will be replaced for any reason with no proof of purchase, so I'd like a replacement.
rules.source_quote: If the product fails to perform for any reason, we will replace it.

rules.title: Craftsman Canada: 3 years on newer power tools, nailers and wet/dry vacuums
rules.window_note: Three years from the date of sale covers corded handheld power tools sold after September 2018: drills, grinders, impact drivers and wrenches, oscillating tools, sanders, saws and wet/dry vacuums. It also covers V20 cordless tools (model numbers starting with CMC) sold after September 2018, and pneumatic nailers and staplers. Corded tools sold before September 2018 (model numbers starting with 9) and compressors get 1 year. You need proof of purchase. Craftsman also lists a 90-day satisfaction guarantee on its corded power tools, nailers and compressors.
rules.what_you_get: A repair or a replacement if there's a fault in the materials or the way it was made.
rules.how_to_claim: Take it back to the store you bought it from, with your receipt. Craftsman says that's where warranty repairs and replacements start. Or contact Craftsman Customer Care through craftsman.ca. If they refuse a real defect, the store that sold it still has to answer under your province's sale-of-goods and consumer protection laws. Small claims court is the last step.
rules.script_hint: This Craftsman [drill] was sold after September 2018 and is less than three years old, and it has a defect, so it's covered by Craftsman's three-year limited warranty. Here is my receipt.
rules.source_quote: For three years from the date of sale, the product is warrantied against defects in material or workmanship.

rules.title: Craftsman Canada: 2 years on mowers, snow throwers and tillers
rules.window_note: Two years from the date of sale, for push mowers, ride-on lawn tractors, snow throwers, tillers and chippers. Some tractors get 3 years (see the box). Gas pressure washers get 3 years on the frame and 2 years on the engine and equipment. Generators get 3 years. Parts that wear out, like mower blades and spark plugs, are not covered.
